    source: _turatsMasterScript + notebookUiScript,
    injectionTime: UserScriptInjectionTime.AT_DOCUMENT_START,
    forMainFrameOnly: true,
  );

  bool? _lastIsDark;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final currentIsDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    if (_lastIsDark != null && _lastIsDark != currentIsDark) {
      _webController?.setSettings(
        settings: InAppWebViewSettings(
          forceDark: currentIsDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
          forceDarkStrategy: ForceDarkStrategy.PREFER_WEB_THEME_OVER_USER_AGENT_DARKENING,
          algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: true,
        ),
      );
      _applyThemeCss();
    }
    _lastIsDark = currentIsDark;

    if (_agent == null) {
      final rawArgs = ModalRoute.of(context)?.settings.arguments;
      if (rawArgs is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        _agent = rawArgs['agent'] as AgentModel?;
        _user = rawArgs['user'] as UserModel?;
      } else if (rawArgs is AgentModel) {
        _agent = rawArgs;
      }
      _agent ??= widget.agent ?? AgentModel.defaultAgents.first;
      _fetchAgentUrl();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _fetchAgentUrl() async {
    _readinessTimer?.cancel();
    TelemetryService.instance.leaveBreadcrumb(
      'Membuka telaah modul: ${_agent?.id}',
      category: 'webview',
    );
    setState(() {
      _isLoadingUrl = true;
      _isWebViewLoading = true;
      _isPaywallRequired = false;
      _agentUrl = null;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    // 0. Cek apakah modul masih berstatus 'coming_soon'
    if (_agent != null && _agent!.isComingSoon) {
      setState(() {
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.preparingModule(_agent!.title);
      });
      return;
    }

    // 1. Pastikan profil pengguna termuat untuk verifikasi hak akses
    _user ??= await _authService.getCurrentUserModel();
    if (!mounted) return;

    // 2. Cek hak akses akun pengguna
    if (_user == null || !_user!.hasAccessToAgent(_agent!.id)) {
      setState(() {
        _isPaywallRequired = true;
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.subscriptionRequiredFor(_agent!.title);
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      final url = await _agentService.getAgentUrl(_agent!.id);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (url == null || url.isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _errorMessage = AppCopy.moduleUnavailable;
          _isLoadingUrl = false;
        });
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _agentUrl = url;
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
      });
      _checkAndShowAdabDialog();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (e is AgentAccessException && (e.code == 'permission-denied' || e.code == 'unauthenticated')) {
        setState(() {
          _errorMessage = e.message;
          _isPaywallRequired = true;
          _isLoadingUrl = false;
        });
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _errorMessage = e is AgentAccessException
            ? e.message
            : AppCopy.studyNotLoadedYet;
        _isPaywallRequired = false;
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _detectGoogleAccessDenied() async {
    if (_webController == null) return;
    try {
      final res = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: """
        (function() {
          var bodyText = document.body ? (document.body.innerText || '') : '';
          var href = window.location.href || '';
          if (href.includes('signin/v2/denied') ||
              href.includes('access_denied') ||
              bodyText.includes('You need access') || 
              bodyText.includes('You do not have access') || 
              bodyText.includes('Request access') ||
              bodyText.includes('Anda memerlukan akses') ||
              bodyText.includes('Minta akses') ||
              bodyText.includes('Anda tidak memiliki akses') ||
              bodyText.includes('beralih ke akun yang memiliki akses') ||
              document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Request access"]') !== null ||
              document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Minta akses"]') !== null ||
              document.querySelector('.auth-error') !== null) {
            return 'DENIED';
          }
          return 'OK';
        })();
      """);
      if (res == 'DENIED' && mounted) {
        TelemetryService.instance.reportError(
          'Google 403 Access Denied on NotebookLM WebView',
          null,
          context: 'webview_access_denied_403',
          severity: 'warning',
          extra: {
            'agentId': _agent?.id ?? '',
            'agentTitle': _agent?.title ?? '',
            'userEmail': _user?.email ?? '',
          },
        );
        setState(() {
          final alreadyEntitled = _user?.hasAccessToAgent(_agent?.id ?? '') ?? false;
          _isPaywallRequired = !alreadyEntitled;
          _isLoadingUrl = false;
          _isWebViewLoading = false;
          _errorMessage = alreadyEntitled
              ? 'Hak akses sudah tercatat. NotebookLM belum mengenali akun ini. Pastikan akun Google sesuai, lalu coba muat kembali.'
              : AppCopy.accessUnavailableFor(_agent?.title ?? 'kajian ini');
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _applyHideScript() async {
    if (_webController == null) return;
    try {
      await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: _turatsMasterScript + notebookUiScript);
      await _applyThemeCss();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _applyThemeCss() async {
    if (_webController == null) return;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    try {
      final themeScript = '''
        (function() {
          try {
            var isDark = $isDark;
            // 1. Standar W3C color-scheme meta tag
            var meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="color-scheme"]');
            if (!meta) {
              meta = document.createElement('meta');
              meta.name = 'color-scheme';
              (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(meta);
            }
            meta.content = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';

            // 2. Sinkronkan class Google Material / NotebookLM tema gelap
            if (document.documentElement) {
              document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark-theme', isDark);
              document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
              document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
              document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
            }
            if (document.body) {
              document.body.classList.toggle('dark-theme', isDark);
              document.body.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
              document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
            }

            // 3. Pastikan latar belakang dasar & elemen internal selaras tanpa flash putih
            var canvasStyleId = 'ot-theme-canvas-style';
            var styleEl = document.getElementById(canvasStyleId);
            if (!styleEl) {
              styleEl = document.createElement('style');
              styleEl.id = canvasStyleId;
              (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(styleEl);
            }
            if (isDark) {
              styleEl.textContent = `
                html, body, [role="main"], mat-sidenav-content, mat-sidenav-container,
                .chat-container, .chat-viewport, .to-user-container, .message-content,
                .rendered-markdown, .query-container, .response-container,
                table, tr, td, th, mat-card, .mat-mdc-card, app-chat-message, app-chat-response,
                .chat-message-container, .notebook-content, .scrollable-content,
                .sources-panel, .studio-panel, div.content-container {
                  background-color: #0E0E10 !important;
                  color: #E4E4E7 !important;
                }
                table, th, td {
                  border-color: #27272A !important;
                }
                a {
                  color: #A1A1AA !important;
                }
              `;
            } else {
              styleEl.textContent = 'html, body { background-color: #FFFFFF !important; color: #18181B !important; }';
            }
          } catch(e) {}
        })();
      ''';
      await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: themeScript);
      await _applyCurrentFontScale();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _saveCopiedAnswer(String text, String ownerUid) async {
    text = text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || text.length > 200000 || _authService.currentUser?.uid != ownerUid) return;
    final agent = _agent;
    if (agent == null) return;
    await _bookmarkService.addBookmark(copiedAnswerBookmark(text, agent), userId: ownerUid);
  }

  Future<void> _copyAnswerToClipboard() async {
    if (_webController == null || _isCopying) return;
    setState(() => _isCopying = true);
    try {
      final result = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.latest() : ""');
      final text = result is String ? result.trim() : '';
      if (text.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) AppSnackBar.warning(context, AppCopy.noAnswerToCopy);
        return;
      }
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _hasCopied = true);
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.answerCopied);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.copyFailed);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isCopying = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveAnswerToBookmarks() async {
    if (_webController == null || _isCopying) return;
    final uid = _authService.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null) return;
    setState(() => _isCopying = true);
    try {
      final result = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.latest() : ""');
      final text = result is String ? result.trim() : '';
      if (text.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) AppSnackBar.warning(context, AppCopy.noAnswerToSave);
        return;
      }
      await _saveCopiedAnswer(text, uid);
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.savedSuccess);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.saveFailed);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isCopying = false);
    }
  }


  void _startReadinessCheck() {
    _readinessTimer?.cancel();
    _loadingStarted = DateTime.now();
    _readySamples = 0;
    _readinessTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), (_) => _checkReady());
  }

  Future<void> _checkReady() async {
    if (_checkingReady || _webController == null || !mounted) return;
    _checkingReady = true;
    try {
      final url = await _webController!.getUrl();
      final isLogin = url?.host == 'accounts.google.com' || url?.host == 'accounts.youtube.com' || url?.host == 'consent.google.com';
      final result = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.ready() : false');
      _readySamples = result == true ? _readySamples + 1 : 0;
      if (!mounted) return;
      final elapsedMs = _loadingStarted != null ? DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inMilliseconds : 0;
      if (isLogin || (_readySamples >= 7 && elapsedMs >= 6500)) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        setState(() => _isWebViewLoading = false);
      } else if (DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inSeconds >= 45) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        setState(() {
          _isWebViewLoading = false;
          _errorMessage = 'AI belum siap merespons. Periksa koneksi lalu coba muat kembali.';
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted && _loadingStarted != null && DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inSeconds >= 45) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        setState(() { _isWebViewLoading = false; _errorMessage = AppCopy.cannotLoad; });
      }
    } finally { _checkingReady = false; }
  }

  Future<void> _handleBackPress() async {
    if (!mounted || _isGoingBack) return;
    _isGoingBack = true;
    setState(() => _isExiting = true);
    // Beri jeda 1 frame agar solid canvas overlay ter-render menutupi SurfaceView WebView
    // sehingga transisi pop route halus tanpa tearing/glitch putih di Android
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 40));
    try {
      await _webController?.stopLoading();
    } catch (_) {}
    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  bool _isNavigatingToSubscription = false;

  Future<void> _navigateToSubscription() async {
    if (_isNavigatingToSubscription) return;
    _isNavigatingToSubscription = true;
    try {
      final currentUser = _user ?? await AuthService().getCurrentUserModel();
      if (!mounted) return;
      await NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
        context,
        AppRoutes.subscription,
        arguments: {
          'agent': _agent,
          'user': currentUser,
        },
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      final refreshedUser = await AuthService().getCurrentUserModel();
      if (mounted && refreshedUser != null) {
        setState(() {
          _user = refreshedUser;
        });
        if (_isPaywallRequired && refreshedUser.hasAccessToAgent(_agent?.id ?? '')) {
          _fetchAgentUrl();
        }
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isNavigatingToSubscription = false);
      } else {
        _isNavigatingToSubscription = false;
      }
    }
  }



  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surfaceSubtle = OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
        if (didPop) return;
        _handleBackPress();
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          toolbarHeight: 56,
          elevation: 0,
          scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded, color: textPrimary, size: 22),
            tooltip: 'Kembali',
            onPressed: _handleBackPress,
          ),
          titleSpacing: 0,
          title: Text(
            _agent?.title ?? AppCopy.studySpace,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: OTTypography.corpusTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
              fontSize: 16,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            if (_user != null && _user!.plan == 'trial')
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 4),
                child: Center(
                  child: InkWell(
                    onTap: _navigateToSubscription,
                    borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: surfaceSubtle,
                        borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                        border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, size: 12, color: accent),
                          const SizedBox(width: 3),
                          Text(
                            '${_user!.questionsRemaining}',
                            style: OTTypography.caption(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined, color: textPrimary, size: 21),
              tooltip: AppCopy.referenceBooks,
              onPressed: () => showResearchLibrary(context, agent: _agent),
            ),
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.more_horiz_rounded, color: textPrimary, size: 22),
              tooltip: AppCopy.studyOptions,
              onPressed: _showOverflowMenu,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.xs),
          ],
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              // ── 1. WebView Layer (Safe Below App Bar) ──
              if (_agentUrl != null)
                Container(
                  color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF0E0E10) : const Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
                  child: InAppWebView(
                    initialUrlRequest: URLRequest(url: WebUri(_agentUrl!)),
                    initialUserScripts: UnmodifiableListView<UserScript>([_cloakScript]),
                    initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
                      userAgent: AppConstants.chromeMobileUserAgent,
                      javaScriptEnabled: true,
                      domStorageEnabled: true,
                      databaseEnabled: true,
                      sharedCookiesEnabled: true,
                      thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
                      cacheEnabled: true,
                      clearCache: false,
                      clearSessionCache: false,
                      useHybridComposition: true,
                      mixedContentMode: MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
                      allowFileAccess: false,
                      allowContentAccess: false,
                      javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically: false,
                      useShouldOverrideUrlLoading: true,
                      supportZoom: true,
                      builtInZoomControls: true,
                      displayZoomControls: false,
                      mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture: false,
                      allowsInlineMediaPlayback: true,
                      forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
                      forceDarkStrategy: ForceDarkStrategy.PREFER_WEB_THEME_OVER_USER_AGENT_DARKENING,
                      algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: true,
                      transparentBackground: false,
                    ),
                onWebViewCreated: (controller) {
                  _webController = controller;
                  final ownerUid = _authService.currentUser?.uid;
                  controller.addJavaScriptHandler(handlerName: 'otCopiedAnswer', callback: (args) async {
                    final url = await controller.getUrl();
                    if (ownerUid == null || url?.scheme != 'https' || !['notebooklm.google.com', 'notebook.google.com'].contains(url?.host) || args.isEmpty || args.first is! String) return false;
                    try {
                      await _saveCopiedAnswer(args.first as String, ownerUid);
                      if (context.mounted) AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.answerCopied);
                      return true;
                    } catch (_) {
                      if (context.mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.saveFailed);
                      return false;
                    }
                  });
                  _startReadinessCheck();
                },
                onLoadStart: (controller, url) {
                  if (mounted) setState(() => _isWebViewLoading = true);
                  _startReadinessCheck();
                },
                onPermissionRequest: (controller, request) async => PermissionResponse(
                  resources: request.resources, action: PermissionResponseAction.DENY,
                ),
                shouldOverrideUrlLoading: (controller, navigationAction) async {
                  final uri = navigationAction.request.url;
                  return uri != null && NotebookNavigation.allowed(uri)
                    ? NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW : NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                },
                onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
                  await _applyHideScript();
                  await _applyCurrentFontScale();
                  await _detectGoogleAccessDenied();
                  await _checkReady();
                },
                onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) async {
                  if (progress >= 25) {
                    await _applyHideScript();
                    await _detectGoogleAccessDenied();
                  }
                  if (progress >= 45) {
                    await _detectGoogleAccessDenied();

                  }
                },
                onReceivedError: (controller, request, error) {
                  if (request.isForMainFrame == true) {
                    TelemetryService.instance.reportError(
                      'WebView Main Frame Error: ${error.description} (code ${error.type})',
                      null,
                      context: 'webview_main_frame_error',
                      severity: 'error',
                      extra: {
                        'agentId': _agent?.id ?? '',
                        'url': request.url.toString(),
                      },
                    );
                  }
                  if (mounted && (request.isForMainFrame == true)) {
                    setState(() {
                      _isWebViewLoading = false;
                      _errorMessage = AppCopy.cannotLoad;
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),

            // ── Loading Indicator Screen (Unified Three Dots Minimal Pulse) ──
            if (_isLoadingUrl || (_isWebViewLoading && _errorMessage == null))
              Positioned.fill(
                child: AppLoader.fullscreen(
                  title: _agent?.title ?? AppCopy.openStudy,
                  subtitle: AppCopy.loadingReferences,
                  onCancel: _handleBackPress,
                ),
              ),

            // ── 2. Error State Screen (Unified AppErrorState) ──
            if (_errorMessage != null && !_isLoadingUrl)
              Positioned.fill(
                child: Container(
                  color: canvas,
                  child: AppErrorState(
                    title: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? AppCopy.subscriptionRequiredTitle
                        : AppCopy.cannotLoadStudy,
                    message: _errorMessage!,
                    icon: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? Icons.workspace_premium_rounded
                        : Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                    onRetry: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? _navigateToSubscription
                        : _fetchAgentUrl,
                    retryLabel: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? AppCopy.viewSubscription
                        : AppCopy.tryAgain,
                    onBack: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    backLabel: 'Kembali ke Beranda',
                  ),
                ),
              ),

            // ── 3. Solid Exit Overlay (Mencegah glitch/tearing SurfaceView Android saat pop) ──
            if (_isExiting)
              Positioned.fill(
                child: Container(
                  color: canvas,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _checkAndShowAdabDialog() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final hasSeen = prefs.getBool('has_acknowledged_adab_talaqqi') ?? false;
      if (!hasSeen && mounted) {
        await _showAdabTalaqqiDialog();
        await prefs.setBool('has_acknowledged_adab_talaqqi', true);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

              onTap: () {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                _showFontScalePicker();
              },
            ),

            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(_hasCopied ? Icons.check_circle_rounded : Icons.copy_rounded, color: _hasCopied ? OTColors.success : textPrimary, size: 20),
              title: Text(AppCopy.copyAnswerAction, style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: textPrimary)),
              onTap: _isCopying
                  ? null
                  : () {

                    },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: Icon(Icons.bookmark_border_rounded, color: textPrimary, size: 20),

                  ? null
                  : () {
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      _saveAnswerToBookmarks();
                    },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showFontScalePicker() {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: surface,
            borderRadius: OTRadius.sheetBorder,
            border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
          ),
          child: SafeArea(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 36,
                      height: 4,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: border,
                        borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(
                    AppCopy.studyOptions,
                    style: OTTypography.corpusTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 17),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    'Sesuaikan ukuran huruf percakapan agar nyaman dibaca.',
                    style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Kecil (85%)', scale: 0.85, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Standar (100%)', scale: 1.0, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Sedang (120%)', scale: 1.20, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Besar (140%)', scale: 1.40, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Sangat besar (165%)', scale: 1.65, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Maksimal (200%)', scale: 2.00, isDark: isDark),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildScaleOption(
    BuildContext ctx, {
    required String label,
    required double scale,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    final isSelected = (_fontScale - scale).abs() < 0.05;
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return ListTile(
      dense: true,
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      leading: Icon(
        Icons.text_fields_rounded,
        size: (18 * scale).clamp(16.0, 24.0),
        color: isSelected ? accent : textSecondary,
      ),
      title: Text(
        label,
        style: OTTypography.body(color: isSelected ? accent : textPrimary).copyWith(
          fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
        ),
      ),
      trailing: isSelected
          ? Icon(Icons.check_rounded, color: accent, size: 20)
          : null,
      onTap: () {
        _setFontScale(scale);
        Navigator.pop(ctx);
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../core/app_copy.dart';

/// Halaman Katalog Kitab (Full-Screen Route).
/// Mendukung 2.226 Kitab Induk lintas 6 disiplin ilmu kanonikal dengan pencarian Arab toleran harakat,
/// filter hierarki disiplin (القسم), abad keilmuan, dan kartu kitab minimalis bergaya turath.
class BookCatalogScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final AgentModel? agent;
  final String? initialQuery;

  const BookCatalogScreen({
    super.key,
    this.agent,
    this.initialQuery,
  });

  @override
  State<BookCatalogScreen> createState() => _BookCatalogScreenState();
}

class _BookCatalogScreenState extends State<BookCatalogScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final CanonicalLibraryService _service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;
  Timer? _debounce;

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _allBooks;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _filteredBooks;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;

  String? _selectedSection;
  String? _selectedEra;
  String? _selectedType;
  String? _selectedCentury;
  String _searchQuery = '';

  List<String> _availableSections = [];
  bool _hasEras = false;
  bool _hasTypes = false;

  final List<String> _eras = [
    'Mutaqaddimin',
    'Ashab Al-Wujuh',
    'Muta\'akhkhirin',
  ];

  final List<String> _types = [
    'Asal Mazhab',
    'Matan',
    'Syarah',
    'Hasyiyah',
  ];

  final List<String> _centuries = [
    'Salaf (≤ 300 H)',
    'Mutaqaddimin (301-600 H)',
    'Muta\'akhkhirin (601-1100 H)',
    'Mu\'ashir (> 1100 H)',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.initialQuery != null && widget.initialQuery!.isNotEmpty) {
      _searchCtrl.text = widget.initialQuery!;
      _searchQuery = widget.initialQuery!;
    }
    _loadCatalog();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    _debounce?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadCatalog() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final List<CanonicalBookPresentation> books;
      if (widget.agent != null) {
        books = await _service.loadCatalogForAgent(widget.agent!);
      } else {
        books = await _service.loadSyafiiCatalog();
      }

      final Set<String> rawSections = {};
      bool hasEras = false;
      bool hasTypes = false;

      for (final b in books) {
        if (b.sectionArabic != null && b.sectionArabic!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
          rawSections.add(b.sectionArabic!.trim());
        }
        if (b.reviewedEraLabel != null && b.reviewedEraLabel!.isNotEmpty) {
          hasEras = true;
        }
        if (b.reviewedTypeLabel != null && b.reviewedTypeLabel!.isNotEmpty) {
          hasTypes = true;
        }
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allBooks = books;
        _availableSections = rawSections.toList()..sort();
        _hasEras = hasEras;
        _hasTypes = hasTypes;
        _isLoading = false;
        _applyFilters();
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.catalogLoadFailed;
      });
    }
  }

  void _onSearchChanged(String val) {
    if (_debounce?.isActive ?? false) _debounce!.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 180), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _searchQuery = val.trim();
          _applyFilters();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  void _applyFilters() {
    if (_allBooks == null) return;
    _filteredBooks = _service.filterBooks(
      _allBooks!,
      _searchQuery,
      sectionFilter: _selectedSection,
      eraFilter: _selectedEra,
      typeFilter: _selectedType,
      centuryFilter: _selectedCentury,
    );
  }

  void _clearFilters() {
    _searchCtrl.clear();
    setState(() {
      _searchQuery = '';
      _selectedSection = null;
      _selectedEra = null;
      _selectedType = null;
      _selectedCentury = null;
      _applyFilters();
    });
  }

  bool get _hasActiveFilters =>
      _searchQuery.isNotEmpty ||
      _selectedSection != null ||
      _selectedEra != null ||
      _selectedType != null ||
      _selectedCentury != null;

  void _openBookDetail(CanonicalBookPresentation book) {
    Navigator.pushNamed(
      context,
      AppRoutes.bookDetail,
      arguments: book,
    );
  }

  String _formatNumber(int number) {
    return number.toString().replaceAllMapped(
      RegExp(r'(\d{1,3})(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))'),
      (Match m) => '${m[1]}.',
    );
  }

  String _cleanSectionLabel(String full) {
    final match = RegExp(r'\((.*?)\)').firstMatch(full);
    if (match != null && match.group(1) != null) {
      return match.group(1)!.trim();
    }
    return full;
  }

  String _resolveSubtitle() {
    if (widget.agent != null) {
      if (_allBooks != null && _allBooks!.isNotEmpty) {
        return '${_formatNumber(_allBooks!.length)} Kitab ${widget.agent!.title}';
      }
      return widget.agent!.title;
    }
    if (_allBooks != null && _allBooks!.isNotEmpty) {
      return '${_formatNumber(_allBooks!.length)} Kitab Mazhab Syafi\'i';
    }
    return '87 Kitab Mazhab Syafi\'i';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final background = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final primaryAccent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: background,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded, color: textPrimary),
          tooltip: 'Kembali',
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        ),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              AppCopy.referenceBooks,
              style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 18),
            ),
            Text(
              _resolveSubtitle(),
              style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary).copyWith(fontSize: 11),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          if (_hasActiveFilters)
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _clearFilters,
              child: Text(
                'Hapus filter',
                style: OTTypography.button(color: primaryAccent).copyWith(fontSize: 13),
              ),
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // ── SEARCH CONTAINER ──
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
                vertical: OTSpacing.sm,
              ),
              child: Container(
                height: 48,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                  border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _searchCtrl,
                        onChanged: _onSearchChanged,
                        style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 13.5, color: textPrimary),
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Cari kitab, pengarang, atau penahkik…',
                          hintStyle: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                          ),
                          border: InputBorder.none,
                          enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          disabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          errorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          focusedErrorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          filled: false,
                          isDense: true,
                          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty)
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () {
                          _searchCtrl.clear();
                          setState(() {
                            _searchQuery = '';
                            _applyFilters();
                          });
                        },
                        child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // ── DYNAMIC HORIZONTAL FILTER CHIPS ──
            _buildFilterChipsBar(
              isDark: isDark,
              surface: surface,
              border: border,
              textPrimary: textPrimary,
              textSecondary: textSecondary,
              primaryAccent: primaryAccent,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),

            // ── RESULTS COUNT HEADER ──
            if (!_isLoading && _filteredBooks != null && _allBooks != null)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
                  vertical: 4,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Menampilkan ${_formatNumber(_filteredBooks!.length)} dari ${_formatNumber(_allBooks!.length)} kitab',
                      style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary).copyWith(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    if (_selectedSection != null ||
                        _selectedEra != null ||
                        _selectedType != null ||
                        _selectedCentury != null)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: primaryAccent.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.12 : 0.06),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          [
                            if (_selectedSection != null) _cleanSectionLabel(_selectedSection!),
                            if (_selectedEra != null) _selectedEra!,
                            if (_selectedType != null) _selectedType!,
                            if (_selectedCentury != null) _selectedCentury!,
                          ].join(' · '),
                          style: OTTypography.caption(color: primaryAccent).copyWith(
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

            // ── MAIN CONTENT LIST / EMPTY / ERROR / LOADING ──
            Expanded(
              child: _buildContent(
                isDark: isDark,
                surface: surface,
                border: border,
                textPrimary: textPrimary,
                textSecondary: textSecondary,
                primaryAccent: primaryAccent,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFilterChipsBar({
    required bool isDark,
    required Color surface,
    required Color border,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required Color primaryAccent,
  }) {
    // Mode 1: Multipel Sub-Bagian (seperti Tafsir & Sastra Arab)
    if (_availableSections.length > 1) {
      return SizedBox(
        height: 38,
        child: ListView(
          physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.lg),
          children: [
            _filterChip(
              label: 'Semua Bagian',
              isSelected: _selectedSection == null,
              onTap: () {
                setState(() {
                  _selectedSection = null;
                  _applyFilters();
                });
              },
              isDark: isDark,
              border: border,
              surface: surface,
              textPrimary: textPrimary,
              textSecondary: textSecondary,
            ),
            for (final section in _availableSections)
              _filterChip(
                label: _cleanSectionLabel(section),
                isSelected: _selectedSection == section,
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() {
                    _selectedSection = _selectedSection == section ? null : section;
                    _applyFilters();
                  });
                },
                isDark: isDark,
                border: border,
                surface: surface,
                textPrimary: textPrimary,
                textSecondary: textSecondary,
              ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    // Mode 2: Mazhab Syafi'i (Era & Tipe Matan/Syarah)
    final isSyafii = widget.agent == null ||
        widget.agent!.id == 'fiqh_syafii' ||
        widget.agent!.catalogId == 'canonical_syafii' ||
        widget.agent!.fieldId == 'fiqh';
    if (isSyafii && (_hasEras || _hasTypes)) {
      return SizedBox(
        height: 38,
        child: ListView(
          physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.lg),
          children: [
            _filterChip(
              label: 'Semua Era',
              isSelected: _selectedEra == null,
              onTap: () {
                setState(() {
                  _selectedEra = null;
                  _applyFilters();
                });
              },
              isDark: isDark,
              border: border,
              surface: surface,
              textPrimary: textPrimary,
              textSecondary: textSecondary,
            ),
            for (final era in _eras)
              _filterChip(
                label: era,
                isSelected: _selectedEra == era,
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() {
                    _selectedEra = _selectedEra == era ? null : era;
                    _applyFilters();
                  });
                },
                isDark: isDark,
                border: border,
                surface: surface,
                textPrimary: textPrimary,
                textSecondary: textSecondary,
              ),
            if (_types.isNotEmpty) ...[
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 8),
                width: 1,
                color: border,
              ),
              for (final type in _types)
                _filterChip(
                  label: type,
                  isSelected: _selectedType == type,
                  onTap: () {
                    setState(() {
                      _selectedType = _selectedType == type ? null : type;
                      _applyFilters();
                    });
                  },
                  isDark: isDark,
                  border: border,
                  surface: surface,
                  textPrimary: textPrimary,
                  textSecondary: textSecondary,
                ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    // Mode 3: Hadits, Ushul Fikih, & Tahawwulat (Abad Kronologis Turath)
    return SizedBox(
      height: 38,
      child: ListView(
        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.lg),
        children: [
          _filterChip(
            label: 'Semua Era',
            isSelected: _selectedCentury == null,
            onTap: () {
              setState(() {
                _selectedCentury = null;
                _applyFilters();
              });
            },
            isDark: isDark,
            border: border,
            surface: surface,
            textPrimary: textPrimary,
            textSecondary: textSecondary,
          ),
          for (final century in _centuries)
            _filterChip(
              label: century,
              isSelected: _selectedCentury == century,
              onTap: () {
                setState(() {
                  _selectedCentury = _selectedCentury == century ? null : century;
                  _applyFilters();
                });
              },
              isDark: isDark,
              border: border,
              surface: surface,
              textPrimary: textPrimary,
              textSecondary: textSecondary,
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildContent({
    required bool isDark,
    required Color surface,
    required Color border,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required Color primaryAccent,
  }) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.lg),
        itemCount: 8,
        itemBuilder: (ctx, i) => _buildSkeletonItem(surface, border),
      );
    }

    if (_errorMessage != null) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.xl),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, size: 48, color: textSecondary),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                _errorMessage!,
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: OTTypography.body(color: textPrimary),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              AppleInteractiveWrapper(
                onTap: _loadCatalog,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 10),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: primaryAccent,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    AppCopy.tryAgain,
                    style: OTTypography.button(color: Colors.white),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (_filteredBooks == null || _filteredBooks!.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.xl),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.search_off_rounded, size: 48, color: textSecondary),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                'Belum ada kitab yang cocok',
                style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                'Coba gunakan kata kunci lain, nama pengarang, atau penahkik.',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
              ),
              if (_hasActiveFilters) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                AppleInteractiveWrapper(
                  onTap: _clearFilters,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      border: Border.all(color: border),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      'Hapus filter',
                      style: OTTypography.button(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 13),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _loadCatalog,
      color: primaryAccent,
      child: ListView.builder(
        physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(parent: BouncingScrollPhysics()),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
          vertical: OTSpacing.sm,
        ),
        itemCount: _filteredBooks!.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final book = _filteredBooks![index];
          return BookRowItem(
            book: book,
            searchQuery: _searchQuery,
            onTap: () => _openBookDetail(book),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSkeletonItem(Color surface, Color border) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: OTSpacing.sm),
      height: 72,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _filterChip({
    required String label,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    required bool isDark,
    required Color border,
    required Color surface,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
  }) {
    final activeBg = textPrimary;
    final activeFg = isDark ? Colors.black : Colors.white;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
      child: AppleInteractiveWrapper(
        onTap: onTap,
        pressedScale: 0.94,
        hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.selection,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 13, vertical: 6),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? activeBg : surface,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected ? activeBg : border,
              width: 0.8,
            ),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: OTTypography.caption(color: isSelected ? activeFg : textSecondary).copyWith(
              fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w500,
              fontSize: 12,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../core/app_snackbar.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';

import '../models/book_model.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import '../services/bookmark_service.dart';
import '../services/research_notes_service.dart';

/// Halaman Detail Edisi Kitab Mandiri (Full-Screen Route).
/// Dirancang sepenuhnya dalam Bahasa Arab Turats dan Tata Letak RTL murni.
/// Menggunakan font Naskh Scheherazade New tanpa font Amiri sama sekali.
class BookDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final CanonicalBookPresentation book;
  final AgentModel? agent;

  const BookDetailScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.book,
    this.agent,
  });

  @override
  State<BookDetailScreen> createState() => _BookDetailScreenState();
}

class _BookDetailScreenState extends State<BookDetailScreen> {
  final ResearchNotesService _notesService = ResearchNotesService();
  bool _isSaving = false;
  bool _isSaved = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _checkIfSaved();
  }

  Future<void> _checkIfSaved() async {
    try {
      final noteId = 'book_${widget.book.editionId}';
      final isBookmarked = await BookmarkService().isBookmarked(noteId);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSaved = isBookmarked);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _toggleSaveBook() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    try {
      final noteId = 'book_${widget.book.editionId}';
      if (_isSaved) {
        await _notesService.deleteNote(noteId);
        await BookmarkService().deleteBookmark(noteId);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isSaved = false;
            _isSaving = false;
          });
          AppSnackBar.show(context, message: 'تمت إزالة الكتاب من الملاحظات');
        }
      } else {
        final agent = _resolveTargetAgent();
        final deathYearStr = widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri != null
            ? ' (ت: ${widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri} هـ)'
            : '';
        final publisherStr = widget.book.publisher != null
            ? '، دار النشر: ${widget.book.publisher}'
            : '';
        final muhaqqiqStr = widget.book.muhaqqiq != null
            ? '، تحقيق: ${widget.book.muhaqqiq}'
            : '';

        final newNote = ResearchNote(
          id: noteId,
          agentId: agent.id,
          agentTitle: agent.title,
          title: widget.book.titleArabic,
          excerpt:
              'كتاب ${widget.book.titleArabic}، للمؤلف ${widget.book.authorArabic}$deathYearStr$publisherStr$muhaqqiqStr.',
          bookTitle: widget.book.titleArabic,
          bookVolume: widget.book.volumesCount?.toString(),
          tags: [
            'بطاقة كتاب',
            if (widget.book.reviewedTypeLabel != null) widget.book.reviewedTypeLabel!,
            if (widget.book.reviewedEraLabel != null) widget.book.reviewedEraLabel!,
          ],
          createdAt: DateTime.now(),
        );

        final newBookmark = BookmarkModel(
          id: noteId,
          title: widget.book.titleArabic,
          agentId: agent.id,
          agentTitle: agent.title,
          fieldName: 'بطاقة كتاب',
          fieldId: 'fiqh',
          arabicExcerpt: widget.book.titleArabic,
          fullAnswer:
              'كتاب ${widget.book.titleArabic}، للمؤلف ${widget.book.authorArabic}$deathYearStr$publisherStr$muhaqqiqStr.',
          bookReference: widget.book.titleArabic,
          pageNumber: '',
          author: widget.book.authorArabic,
          createdAt: DateTime.now(),
        );

        await _notesService.saveNote(newNote);
        await BookmarkService().addBookmark(newBookmark);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isSaved = true;
            _isSaving = false;
          });
          HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
          AppSnackBar.success(context, 'تم حفظ بيانات الكتاب في الملاحظات');
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSaving = false);
        AppSnackBar.error(context, 'تعذر تحديث الملاحظات');
      }
    }
  }

  AgentModel _resolveTargetAgent() {
    if (widget.agent != null) return widget.agent!;
    try {
      return AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere(
        (a) => a.catalogId == 'canonical_syafii' || a.id == 'fiqh',
        orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      return AgentModel.defaultAgents.first;
    }
  }

  void _copyScholarlyCitation() {
    final deathYearStr = widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri != null
        ? ' (ت: ${widget.book.verifiedDeathYearHijri} هـ)'
        : '';
    final publisherStr = widget.book.publisher != null
        ? '، دار النشر: ${widget.book.publisher}'
        : '';
    final muhaqqiqStr = widget.book.muhaqqiq != null
        ? '، تحقيق: ${widget.book.muhaqqiq}'
        : '';
    final volStr = (widget.book.volumesDescription != null && widget.book.volumesDescription!.isNotEmpty)
        ? '، ${widget.book.volumesDescription}'
        : (widget.book.volumesCount != null ? '، ${widget.book.volumesCount} أجزاء' : '');
    final printYearStr = (widget.book.printYear != null && widget.book.printYear != '-')
        ? '، سنة الطبع: ${widget.book.printYear}'
        : '';

    final citation =
        '${widget.book.authorArabic}$deathYearStr، ${widget.book.titleArabic}$muhaqqiqStr$publisherStr$printYearStr$volStr.';

    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: citation));
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    AppSnackBar.success(context, 'تم نسخ بطاقة الكتاب بنجاح');
  }

  String _translateType(String? type) {
    if (type == null || type.isEmpty) return 'مصنف علمي';
    final l = type.toLowerCase();
    if (l.contains('matn') || l.contains('matan')) return 'متن معتمد';
    if (l.contains('syarah') || l.contains('sharh')) return 'شرح';
    if (l.contains('hasyiyah') || l.contains('hashiyah')) return 'حاشية';
    if (l.contains('mukhtasar') || l.contains('ringkasan')) return 'مختصر';
    if (l.contains('ensiklopedia') || l.contains('mausuah')) return 'موسوعة فقهية';
    if (l.contains('manzhumah') || l.contains('nazham')) return 'منظومة علمية';
    return type;
  }

  String _translateEra(String? era) {
    if (era == null || era.isEmpty) return 'التراث الإسلامي';
    final l = era.toLowerCase();
    if (l.contains('mutaqaddim') || l.contains('awal')) return 'عصر المتقدمين (حتى ٤٠٠ هـ)';
    if (l.contains('mutawassith') || l.contains('pertengahan')) return 'عصر المتوسطين (٤٠٠ - ٨٠٠ هـ)';
    if (l.contains('muta\'akhkhir') || l.contains('mutaakhir') || l.contains('lanjut')) return 'عصر المتأخرين (٨٠٠ - ١٢٠٠ هـ)';
    if (l.contains('mu\'ashir') || l.contains('kontemporer') || l.contains('modern')) return 'العصر المعاصر (بعد ١٢٠٠ هـ)';
    return era;
  }

  String _formatVolumes() {
    final vd = widget.book.volumesDescription;
    if (vd != null && vd.isNotEmpty) {
      return (vd.contains('جزء') || vd.contains('مجلد')) ? vd : '$vd أجزاء';
    }
    final count = widget.book.volumesCount;
    if (count != null && count > 1) return '$count أجزاء';
    return 'جزء واحد (مجلد مفرد)';
  }

                        textSecondary: textSecondary,
                      ),
                      if (widget.book.printYear != null && widget.book.printYear != '-') ...[
                        const Divider(height: 16, thickness: 0.5),
                        _buildMetaRow(
                          icon: Icons.calendar_today_outlined,
                          label: 'سنة الطبع',
                          value: widget.book.printYear!,
                          textPrimary: textPrimary,
                          textSecondary: textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xl),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCard({
    required bool isDark,
    required Color surface,
    required Color border,
    required Widget child,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.lg),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: surface,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.card),
        border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSectionHeader(String title, Color color) {
    return Text(
      title,
      style: OTTypography.arabicReading(color: color).copyWith(
        fontSize: 13,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMetaRow({
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required String value,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
  }) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Icon(icon, size: 18, color: textSecondary),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Text(
          label,
          style: OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textSecondary).copyWith(
            fontSize: 13.5,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
        const Spacer(),
        Flexible(
          child: Text(
            value,
            textAlign: TextAlign.start,
            style: OTTypography.arabicReading(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
              fontSize: 13.5,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown/flutter_markdown.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';

import '../core/app_copy.dart';
import '../core/app_snackbar.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_colors.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_typography.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_radius.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_motion.dart';
import '../core/design/ot_spacing.dart';
import '../core/routes.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import '../models/book_model.dart';
import '../services/bookmark_service.dart';
import '../services/canonical_library_service.dart';
import '../widgets/note_editor_sheet.dart';
import 'main_shell_screen.dart';

class BookmarkScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const BookmarkScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<BookmarkScreen> createState() => _BookmarkScreenState();
}

class _BookmarkScreenState extends State<BookmarkScreen> {
  final BookmarkService _bookmarkService = BookmarkService();
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  List<BookmarkModel> _allBookmarks = [];
  List<BookmarkModel> _filteredBookmarks = [];
  String _selectedCategory = 'Semua';
  String _searchQuery = '';
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _showSearch = false;

  static const List<String> _categories = [
    'Semua',
    'Catatan',
    'Ibarah Kitab',
    'Rujukan Kitab',
    'Fikih',
    'Hadis',
    'Tafsir',
    'Akidah',
    'Usul Fikih',
    'Bahasa Arab',
    'Sejarah',
    'Tasawuf & Akhlak',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadBookmarks();
    _bookmarkService.addListener(_onBookmarksChanged);
    _bookmarkService.syncWithCloud();
  }

  Future<void> _syncBookmarks() async {
    await _bookmarkService.syncWithCloud();
    await _loadBookmarks();
  }

  void _onBookmarksChanged() {
    if (mounted) {
      _loadBookmarks();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _bookmarkService.removeListener(_onBookmarksChanged);
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadBookmarks() async {
    final list = await _bookmarkService.getBookmarks();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _allBookmarks = list;
        _filter();
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _filter() {
    final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    _filteredBookmarks = _allBookmarks.where((b) {
      final fieldLower = b.fieldName.toLowerCase();
      final isBookRef = b.id.startsWith('book_') || fieldLower.contains('rujukan kitab');

      bool matchesCategory;
      if (_selectedCategory == 'Semua') {
        matchesCategory = true;
      } else if (_selectedCategory == 'Rujukan Kitab') {
        matchesCategory = isBookRef;
      } else if (_selectedCategory == 'Ibarah Kitab') {
        matchesCategory = !isBookRef && !fieldLower.contains('catatan');
      } else if (_selectedCategory == 'Catatan') {
        matchesCategory = fieldLower.contains('catatan');
      } else {
        matchesCategory = fieldLower.contains(_selectedCategory.toLowerCase()) ||
            (_selectedCategory == 'Hadis' && fieldLower.contains('hadits')) ||
            (_selectedCategory == 'Sejarah' && fieldLower.contains('tarikh')) ||
            (_selectedCategory == 'Akidah' && fieldLower.contains('aqidah')) ||
            (_selectedCategory == 'Usul Fikih' && fieldLower.contains('ushul')) ||
            (_selectedCategory == 'Tasawuf & Akhlak' &&
                (fieldLower.contains('tasawuf') ||
                    fieldLower.contains('tasawwuf') ||
                    fieldLower.contains('akhlak')));
      }

      if (!matchesCategory) return false;
      if (q.isEmpty) return true;
      return b.title.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          b.agentTitle.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          b.bookReference.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
          b.arabicExcerpt.contains(q) ||
          b.fullAnswer.toLowerCase().contains(q);
    }).toList();
  }

  Future<void> _deleteBookmark(BookmarkModel item) async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
          title: Text(
            'Hapus catatan?',
            style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 18),
          ),
          content: Text(
            'Catatan ini akan dihapus permanen.',
            style: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text(
                'Batal',
                style: OTTypography.button(color: textSecondary),
              ),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: OTColors.destructive,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
              ),
              child: Text(
                'Hapus',
                style: OTTypography.button(color: Colors.white),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (confirm == true) {
      await _bookmarkService.deleteBookmark(item.id);
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.show(
          context,
          message: 'Catatan dihapus.',
          action: SnackBarAction(
            label: 'Urungkan',
            textColor: OTColors.accent(isDark),
            onPressed: () => _bookmarkService.addBookmark(item),
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  void _copyIbarah(String ibarah) {
    OTMotion.light();
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: ibarah));
    AppSnackBar.success(context, 'Ibarah tersalin.');
  }

  void _shareBookmark(BookmarkModel item) {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    if (item.arabicExcerpt.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('"${item.arabicExcerpt}"');
      buffer.writeln();
    }
    buffer.write('— ');
    if (item.bookReference.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.write('Kitab ${item.bookReference}');
      if (item.pageNumber.isNotEmpty) {
        buffer.write(' (Hal. ${item.pageNumber})');
      }
    } else {
      buffer.write(item.title);
    }
    if (item.author != null && item.author!.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.write(', karya ${item.author}');
    }
    buffer.write('.');

    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: buffer.toString()));
    AppSnackBar.success(
      context,
      AppCopy.referenceCopied,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openNoteEditor([BookmarkModel? item]) async {
    final res = await NoteEditorSheet.show(context, item: item);
    if (res != null && mounted) {
      _loadBookmarks();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openBookmarkItem(BookmarkModel item) async {
    if (item.id.startsWith('book_')) {
      final editionId = item.id.replaceFirst('book_', '');
      var books = CanonicalLibraryService.instance.cachedSyafiiBooks;
      if (books == null) {
        try {
          books = await CanonicalLibraryService.instance.loadSyafiiCatalog();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      final matchedBook = books?.firstWhere(
        (b) => b.editionId == editionId,
        orElse: () => CanonicalBookPresentation(
          editionId: editionId,
          titleArabic: item.title,
          authorArabic: item.author ?? '',
        ),
      );

      if (matchedBook != null && mounted) {
        Navigator.pushNamed(
          context,
          AppRoutes.bookDetail,
          arguments: matchedBook,
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    _openNoteEditor(item);
  }

class _BookmarkCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final BookmarkModel item;
  final Color surface;
  final Color surfaceSubtle;
  final Color border;
  final Color textPrimary;
  final Color textSecondary;
  final Color accent;
  final VoidCallback onEdit;
  final VoidCallback onCopy;
  final VoidCallback onOpen;
  final VoidCallback onShare;
  final VoidCallback onDelete;

  const _BookmarkCard({
    required this.item,
    required this.surface,
    required this.surfaceSubtle,
    required this.border,
    required this.textPrimary,
    required this.textSecondary,
    required this.accent,
    required this.onEdit,
    required this.onCopy,
    required this.onOpen,
    required this.onShare,
    required this.onDelete,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isBookRef = item.id.startsWith('book_') || item.fieldName == 'Rujukan Kitab';
    final hasValidBookRef = item.bookReference.isNotEmpty &&
        !item.bookReference.toLowerCase().contains('belum diidentifikasi');

    return InkWell(
      onTap: onEdit,
      borderRadius: OTRadius.cardBorder,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.base),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: surface,
          borderRadius: OTRadius.cardBorder,
          border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Header: Category Pill + Agent Title + Delete
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: accent.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                          borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          isBookRef
                              ? 'Rujukan Kitab'
                              : (item.fieldName.contains('Catatan') ? 'Catatan' : item.fieldName),
                          style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: accent).copyWith(
                            fontSize: 11,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.sm),
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          item.agentTitle,
                          style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(
                    Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                    size: 20,
                    color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                  ),
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44),
                  tooltip: 'Hapus catatan',
                  onPressed: onDelete,
                ),
              ],
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),

            // Title
            Text(
              item.title,
              style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary),
            ),

            if (hasValidBookRef) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
              // Book Reference Pill
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: surfaceSubtle,
                  borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                  border: Border.all(color: border.withValues(alpha: 0.6), width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.menu_book_rounded, size: 14, color: accent),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        '${item.bookReference}${item.pageNumber.isNotEmpty ? " · Hlm. ${item.pageNumber}" : ""}',
                        style: OTTypography.captionMedium(color: textPrimary),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],

            if (item.arabicExcerpt.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),
              // Arabic Excerpt Box
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: surfaceSubtle,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(OTRadius.input),
                  border: Border.all(color: border.withValues(alpha: 0.4), width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  item.arabicExcerpt,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: GoogleFonts.tajawal(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    height: 1.6,
                    color: textPrimary,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 3,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ),
            ],

            // Markdown Body Excerpt
            if (item.fullAnswer.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
              MarkdownBody(
                data: item.fullAnswer.length > 250
                    ? '${item.fullAnswer.substring(0, 250).trim()}...'
                    : item.fullAnswer.trim(),
                styleSheet: MarkdownStyleSheet(
                  p: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    height: 1.5,
                    color: textSecondary,
                  ),
                  strong: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: textPrimary,
                  ),
                  blockquote: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: 12.5,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    color: textSecondary,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],

            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),

            // Action Buttons
            Row(
              children: [
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: onEdit,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, size: 14),
                  label: const Text('Edit'),
                  style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                    foregroundColor: textPrimary,
                    side: BorderSide(color: border, width: 0.8),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    textStyle: OTTypography.captionMedium(),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.xs + 2),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: onCopy,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded, size: 14),
                  label: Text(
                    item.arabicExcerpt.isNotEmpty
                        ? AppCopy.copyIbarahAction
                        : (isBookRef
                            ? 'Salin rujukan'
                            : (item.fieldName.contains('Catatan') ? 'Salin catatan' : 'Salin jawaban')),
                  ),
                  style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                    foregroundColor: textPrimary,
                    side: BorderSide(color: border, width: 0.8),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    textStyle: OTTypography.captionMedium(),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
                  ),
                ),
                if (isBookRef) ...[
                  const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.xs + 2),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: onOpen,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.menu_book, size: 14),
                    label: const Text('Lihat rujukan'),
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: surfaceSubtle,
                      foregroundColor: textPrimary,
                      elevation: 0,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                      textStyle: OTTypography.captionMedium(),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
                const Spacer(),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: onShare,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.share_outlined, size: 18),
                  tooltip: AppCopy.shareReferenceTooltip,
                  color: textSecondary,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
