import '../core/navigation_guard.dart';
import '../widgets/update_ready_banner.dart';
import '../widgets/specialist_card.dart';
import '../widgets/library_bottom_sheet.dart';
import '../widgets/apple_interactive_wrapper.dart';
import 'main_shell_screen.dart';

/// Beranda OpenTurath AI (Tactile Scholarly Research Desk)
/// Dilengkapi animasi Apple Interactive micro-compression, pantulan pegas halus,
/// penanggalan ganda Hijriah, pencarian naskah seketika, dan portal keilmuan interaktif.
class DashboardScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DashboardScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<DashboardScreen> createState() => _DashboardScreenState();
}

class _DashboardScreenState extends State<DashboardScreen> {
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  final AgentService _agentService = AgentService();
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();

  UserModel? _initialUser;
  List<AgentModel> _agents = AgentModel.defaultAgents;
  String _searchQuery = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
    UpdateService().checkForUpdatesSilently();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    try {
      if (_authService.currentUser == null) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.login);
        return;
      }

      final results = await Future.wait([
        _authService.getCurrentUserModel(),
        _agentService.getAgents(),
      ]).timeout(
        const Duration(seconds: 4),
        onTimeout: () => [null, AgentModel.defaultAgents],
      );

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _initialUser = results[0] as UserModel?;
        _agents = results[1] as List<AgentModel>;
      });
    } catch (_) {
    }
  }

  void _openNotebook(AgentModel agent, UserModel? user) {
    if (agent.isComingSoon) {
      AppSnackBar.warning(
        context,
        'Koleksi kitab untuk ${agent.title} masih disiapkan.',
      );
      return;
    }

    // Rekam riwayat pembukaan terakhir secara asynchronous di background
    SharedPreferences.getInstance().then((prefs) {
      prefs.setString('last_opened_notebook_id', agent.id);
    }).catchError((_) {});

    // Cek akses pengguna ke agent (paywall)
    if (user == null || !user.hasAccessToAgent(agent.id)) {
      NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
        context,
        AppRoutes.subscription,
        arguments: {'user': user, 'agent': agent},
      );
      return;
    }

    // Buka ruang kajian multi-tab secara seketika (0ms delay)
    AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(agent, user: user);
  }

  static const List<({String fieldId, String name, int specialistCount})> _curatedDisciplines = [
    (fieldId: 'fiqh', name: 'Fikih', specialistCount: 6),
    (fieldId: 'hadith', name: 'Hadis', specialistCount: 1),
    (fieldId: 'tafsir', name: 'Tafsir', specialistCount: 1),
    (fieldId: 'aqidah', name: 'Akidah', specialistCount: 1),
    (fieldId: 'usul', name: 'Usul Fikih', specialistCount: 1),
    (fieldId: 'lughah', name: 'Bahasa Arab', specialistCount: 1),
  ];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return StreamBuilder<UserModel?>(
      stream: _authService.userStream,
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        final curFirebaseUser = _authService.currentUser;
        final user = snapshot.data ??
            _initialUser ??
            UserModel(
              uid: curFirebaseUser?.uid ?? 'user',
              name: curFirebaseUser?.displayName?.isNotEmpty == true
                  ? curFirebaseUser!.displayName!
                  : 'Ahlan',
              email: curFirebaseUser?.email ?? '',
              photoUrl: curFirebaseUser?.photoURL ?? '',
              plan: AppConstants.planTrial,
              questionsUsed: 0,
            );

        return Scaffold(
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          body: SafeArea(
            bottom: false,
            child: RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: _loadData,
              color: accent,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(parent: AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics()),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 96),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    // ── 1. Header Centered: OpenTurath ──
                    Center(
                      child: Text(
                        'OpenTurath',
                        style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                          fontSize: 26,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          letterSpacing: -0.4,
                          color: textPrimary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: 18),

                    // Banner pembaruan jika tersedia
                    const UpdateReadyBanner(),

                    // ── 2. Minimalist Monochrome Greeting Card (Black/White/Grey Palette) ──
                    Container(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF141416) : Colors.white,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF27272A) : const Color(0xFFE5E7EB),
                          width: 1.0,
                        ),
                        boxShadow: isDark
                            ? null
                            : [
                                BoxShadow(
                                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
                                  blurRadius: 10,
                                  offset: const Offset(0, 3),
                                ),
                              ],
                      ),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          // Baris Atas: Sapaan [Nama]
                          Text(
                            user.name.isNotEmpty && user.name != 'Ahlan' ? 'Ahlan, ${user.name}' : 'Ahlan',
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                              fontSize: 18,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              letterSpacing: -0.3,
                              color: isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF18181B),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 14),
                          // Baris Bawah: Dua Pill Tanggal Monokrom (Masehi & Hijriah)
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Expanded(
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 7),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E1E22) : const Color(0xFFF4F4F5),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                      color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF3F3F46) : const Color(0xFFE4E4E7),
                                      width: 0.8,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: Row(
                                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                    children: [
                                      Icon(
                                        Icons.calendar_today_outlined,
                                        size: 13,
                                        color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFA1A1AA) : const Color(0xFF71717A),
                                      ),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                      Flexible(
                                        child: Text(
                                          HijriDateUtils.formatMasehiOnly(),
                                          maxLines: 1,
                                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                            fontSize: 11.5,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                            color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFD4D4D8) : const Color(0xFF3F3F46),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 7),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E1E22) : const Color(0xFFF4F4F5),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                      color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF3F3F46) : const Color(0xFFE4E4E7),
                                      width: 0.8,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: Row(
                                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                    children: [
                                      Icon(
                                        Icons.nightlight_outlined,
                                        size: 13,
                                        color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFA1A1AA) : const Color(0xFF71717A),
                                      ),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                      Flexible(
                                        child: Text(
                                          HijriDateUtils.formatHijriOnly(),
                                          maxLines: 1,
                                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                            fontSize: 11.5,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                            color: isDark ? const Color(0xFFD4D4D8) : const Color(0xFF3F3F46),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: 16),

                    // ── 3. Announcement & Adab Carousel (Tepat di bawah greeting card) ──
                    _DashboardAnnouncementCarousel(
                      isDark: isDark,
                      surface: surface,
                      border: border,
                      textPrimary: textPrimary,
                      textSecondary: textSecondary,
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: 18),

                    // ── 3. Ergonomic Search Bar (Stadium Pill) ──
                    Container(
                      height: 48,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: surface,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                        border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1.0),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Expanded(
                            child: TextField(
                              controller: _searchController,
                              onChanged: (val) => setState(() => _searchQuery = val.trim()),
                              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 13.5, color: textPrimary),
                              decoration: InputDecoration(
                                hintText: 'Cari asisten, kitab, atau bab…',
                                hintStyle: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 13.5, color: textSecondary),
                                border: InputBorder.none,
                                enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                disabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                errorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                focusedErrorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                                filled: false,
                                isDense: true,
                                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty)
                            GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () {
                                _searchController.clear();
                                setState(() => _searchQuery = '');
                              },
                              child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: 22),

                    // ── 4. Jika Sedang Mencari (Hasil Realtime) ──
                    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      Text(
                        'Hasil pencarian',
                        style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          letterSpacing: -0.2,
                          color: textPrimary,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Builder(
                        builder: (context) {
                          final q = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
                          final matches = _agents.where((a) {
                            final title = a.title.toLowerCase();
                            final arabic = a.titleArabic;
                            final subtitle = a.subtitleAcademic.toLowerCase();
                            final category = a.category.toLowerCase();
                            final books = a.referenceBooks?.any((b) => b.title.toLowerCase().contains(q)) ?? false;
                            return title.contains(q) || arabic.contains(q) || subtitle.contains(q) || category.contains(q) || books;
                          }).toList();

                          if (matches.isEmpty) {
                            return Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 36),
                              child: Center(
                                child: Text(
                                  'Belum ada asisten atau kitab yang cocok. Coba kata kunci lain.',
                                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 13.5, color: textSecondary),
                                ),
                              ),
                            );
                          }

                          return ListView.separated(
                            shrinkWrap: true,
                            physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                            itemCount: matches.length,
                            separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 10),
                            itemBuilder: (context, idx) {
                              final agent = matches[idx];
                              return SpecialistCard(
                                title: agent.title,
                                statusLabel: agent.isComingSoon ? 'Segera hadir' : null,
                                onOpen: () => _openNotebook(agent, user),
                                onOpenLibrary: agent.catalogId != null
                                    ? () => showResearchLibrary(context, agent: agent)
                                    : null,
                              );
                            },
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ] else ...[
                      // ── Section: Pilih Bidang ──
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            'Pilih bidang',
                            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                              fontSize: 16,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              letterSpacing: -0.2,
                              color: textPrimary,
                            ),
                          ),
                          GestureDetector(
                            onTap: () {
                              final shell = MainShellController.of(context);
                              if (shell != null) {
                                shell.switchTab(1);
                              } else {
                                Navigator.pushNamed(context, AppRoutes.specialistList);
                              }
                            },
                            child: Row(
                              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  'Lihat semua',
                                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                    color: textPrimary,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 2),
                                Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, size: 16, color: textPrimary),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),

                      const SizedBox(height: 14),

                      // 2-Column Minimalist Purism Grid (6 Cards, Aspect Ratio 1.45)
                      GridView.builder(
                        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                        shrinkWrap: true,
                        gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
                          crossAxisCount: 2,
                          crossAxisSpacing: 12,
                          mainAxisSpacing: 12,
                          childAspectRatio: 1.45,
                        ),
                        itemCount: _curatedDisciplines.length,
                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          final disc = _curatedDisciplines[index];
                          return AppleInteractiveWrapper(
                            onTap: () {
                              final shell = MainShellController.of(context);
                              if (shell != null) {
                                shell.switchTab(1, fieldId: disc.fieldId);
                              } else {
                                Navigator.pushNamed(
                                  context,
                                  AppRoutes.specialistList,
                                  arguments: {'fieldId': disc.fieldId},
                                );
                              }
                            },
                            pressedScale: 0.96,
                            hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.light,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                            child: Container(
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: surface,
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                                border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1.0),
                              ),
                              child: Column(
                                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    disc.name,
                                    style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                                      fontSize: 18,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                      letterSpacing: -0.2,
                                      color: textPrimary,
                                    ),
                                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 5),
                                  Text(
                                    '${disc.specialistCount} asisten',
                                    style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                      fontSize: 12.5,
                                      color: textSecondary,
                                    ),
                                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }



}

class _DashboardAnnouncementCarousel extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool isDark;
  final Color surface;
  final Color border;
  final Color textPrimary;
  final Color textSecondary;

  const _DashboardAnnouncementCarousel({
    required this.isDark,
    required this.surface,
    required this.border,
    required this.textPrimary,
    required this.textSecondary,
  });

  @override
  State<_DashboardAnnouncementCarousel> createState() =>
      _DashboardAnnouncementCarouselState();
}

class _DashboardAnnouncementCarouselState
    extends State<_DashboardAnnouncementCarousel> {
  late final PageController _pageController;
  int _currentPage = 0;
  Timer? _autoPlayTimer;

  static const List<_AnnouncementSlide> _slides = [
    _AnnouncementSlide(
      badge: 'TENTANG OPENTURATH',
      title: 'Mengenal OpenTurath',
      summary: 'Membaca ibarah dan menelusuri rujukan langsung dari kitab.',
      detailedContent:
          'Gunakan OpenTurath untuk mencari rujukan dan membandingkan matan dengan syarah. Periksa hasilnya pada kitab asal, lalu diskusikan dengan guru dan ulama yang berkompeten.',
    ),
    _AnnouncementSlide(
      badge: 'ADAB BELAJAR',
      title: 'Tetap Belajar Bersama Guru',
      summary: 'Belajarlah dengan bimbingan guru dan ulama yang bersanad.',
      detailedContent:
          'AI membantu mencari ibarah dan membandingkan penjelasan dalam kitab. Untuk memahami fikih dan fatwa, tetaplah belajar kepada guru dan ulama yang bersanad.',
    ),
    _AnnouncementSlide(
      badge: 'PERIKSA SUMBER',
      title: 'Cocokkan dengan Kitab Asal',
      summary: 'Periksa kembali kutipan di Maktabah Syamilah atau kitab cetak.',
      detailedContent:
          'Baca ibarah beserta konteksnya pada kitab cetak yang dirujuk sebelum menarik kesimpulan atau membagikan hasil kajian.',
    ),
    _AnnouncementSlide(
      badge: 'AMANAH ILMIAH',
      title: 'Cantumkan Rujukan Saat Mengutip',
      summary: 'Sertakan nama pengarang, judul kitab, bab, jilid, dan halaman.',
      detailedContent:
          'Saat mengutip, tuliskan nama pengarang, judul kitab, bab, jilid, dan halaman sesuai sumber yang digunakan agar rujukan mudah ditemukan.',
    ),
    _AnnouncementSlide(
      badge: 'TELUSURI RUJUKAN',
      title: 'Lihat Asal Kutipan',
      summary: 'Gunakan informasi kitab, jilid, dan halaman untuk memeriksa naskah.',
      detailedContent:
          'Buka rujukan yang tersedia untuk menelusuri asal kutipan. Cocokkan teks, jilid, dan halaman dengan edisi kitab yang Anda gunakan.',
    ),
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pageController = PageController(viewportFraction: 0.93);
    _startAutoPlay();
  }

  void _startAutoPlay() {
    _autoPlayTimer?.cancel();
    _autoPlayTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 8), (timer) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (_pageController.hasClients) {
        final nextPage = (_currentPage + 1) % _slides.length;
        _pageController.animateToPage(
          nextPage,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 450),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        );
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _autoPlayTimer?.cancel();
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _showDetailModal(_AnnouncementSlide slide) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: widget.surface,
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
            border: Border.all(color: widget.border, width: 1.0),
          ),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 16, 24, 32),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 36,
                  height: 4,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 18),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: widget.textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: widget.isDark ? const Color(0xFF27272A) : const Color(0xFFF4F4F5),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: widget.isDark ? const Color(0xFF3F3F46) : const Color(0xFFE4E4E7),
                    width: 0.8,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  slide.badge,
                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                    fontSize: 10.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    letterSpacing: 0.4,
                    color: widget.textSecondary,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                slide.title,
                style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                  fontSize: 22,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  letterSpacing: -0.3,
                  color: widget.textPrimary,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                slide.detailedContent,
                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                  fontSize: 14,
                  height: 1.55,
                  color: widget.textSecondary,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                height: 44,
                child: FilledButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: widget.isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF18181B),
                    foregroundColor: widget.isDark ? const Color(0xFF18181B) : Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    'Tutup',
                    style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        SizedBox(
          height: 146,
          child: NotificationListener<ScrollNotification>(
            onNotification: (notification) {
              if (notification is ScrollStartNotification) {
                _autoPlayTimer?.cancel();
              } else if (notification is ScrollEndNotification) {
                _startAutoPlay();
              }
              return false;
            },
            child: PageView.builder(
              controller: _pageController,
              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
              itemCount: _slides.length,
              onPageChanged: (index) {
                setState(() => _currentPage = index);
              },
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final slide = _slides[index];
                return InkWell(
                  onTap: () => _showDetailModal(slide),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  child: Container(
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: widget.surface,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: widget.border,
                        width: 1.0,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2.5),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: widget.isDark ? const Color(0xFF27272A) : const Color(0xFFF4F4F5),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: widget.isDark ? const Color(0xFF3F3F46) : const Color(0xFFE4E4E7),
                                  width: 0.8,
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                slide.badge,
                                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  letterSpacing: 0.3,
                                  color: widget.textSecondary,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            Row(

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';

import '../core/routes.dart';

import '../services/auth_service.dart';

/// Gerbang Sesi Google (Pre-Auth Gate)
/// Memastikan kuki autentikasi Google aktif di WebView sehingga pengguna
/// langsung dapat membuka NotebookLM tanpa kendala masuk berulang.
class GoogleSessionAuthScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const GoogleSessionAuthScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<GoogleSessionAuthScreen> createState() =>
      _GoogleSessionAuthScreenState();
}

class _GoogleSessionAuthScreenState extends State<GoogleSessionAuthScreen> {
  InAppWebViewController? _webController;
  bool _isSessionReady = false;
  final ValueNotifier<double> _loadProgress = ValueNotifier<double>(0.0);

  static const String _chromeUserAgent =
      "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; Mobile) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.6613.127 Mobile Safari/537.36";

  static const String _targetLoginUrl =
      "https://accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin?continue=https://notebook.google.com/";

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _loadProgress.dispose();
    _webController = null;
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Simpan status sesi dan arahkan ke Dashboard
  Future<void> _onSessionAuthenticated() async {
    if (!mounted || _isSessionReady) return;
    setState(() => _isSessionReady = true);

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setBool('google_session_ready', true);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.dashboard);
  }

  Future<void> _confirmCancelAndSignOut() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final shouldSignOut = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard)),
        title: Text(
          'Batalkan proses masuk?',
          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight,
          ),
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Hubungkan akun Google agar NotebookLM dapat dibuka tanpa perlu masuk ulang.',
          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: Text(
              'Tetap di Sini',
              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                color: isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: AppTheme.appleRed,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusPill)),
            ),
            child: Text(
              'Keluar',
              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (shouldSignOut == true && mounted) {
      await AuthService().signOut();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.login);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = isDark ? AppTheme.canvasDark : AppTheme.canvasLight;
    final surface = isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
    final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
    final textSecondary = isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;
    final accent = isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight;

    if (_isSessionReady) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        body: const Center(
          child: AppLoader(
            title: 'Sesi Google Terhubung',
            subtitle: 'Menyiapkan akses kitab.',
            dotSize: 10,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) async {
        if (didPop) return;
        final canGoBack = await _webController?.canGoBack() ?? false;
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (canGoBack) {
          await _webController?.goBack();
        } else {
          await _confirmCancelAndSignOut();
        }
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          elevation: 0,
          scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
          titleSpacing: 16,
          title: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                'Hubungkan akun Google',
                style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                  fontSize: 17,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: textPrimary,
                  letterSpacing: -0.2,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                'Gunakan akun Google untuk membuka NotebookLM',
                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: textSecondary,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Keluar',
              icon: Icon(Icons.logout_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
              onPressed: _confirmCancelAndSignOut,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
          ],
          bottom: PreferredSize(
            preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(2),
            child: ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
              valueListenable: _loadProgress,
              builder: (context, progress, child) {
                if (progress >= 1.0) return const SizedBox(height: 2);
                return LinearProgressIndicator(
                  value: progress,
                  backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                  valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(accent),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // Banner Penjelasan Transparan
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 10),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
                  border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, size: 18, color: accent),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        'Masuk dengan akun Google yang memiliki akses ke kitab ini.',
                        style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                          fontSize: 12,
                          height: 1.35,
                          color: textSecondary,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: surface,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
                    border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1),
                  ),
                  clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                  child: InAppWebView(
                    initialUrlRequest: URLRequest(url: WebUri(_targetLoginUrl)),
                    initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
                      userAgent: _chromeUserAgent,
                      javaScriptEnabled: true,
                      domStorageEnabled: true,
                      databaseEnabled: true,
                      sharedCookiesEnabled: true,
                      thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
                      useHybridComposition: true,
                      supportMultipleWindows: false,
                      useShouldOverrideUrlLoading: true,
                      javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically: false,
                      mixedContentMode: MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
                      allowFileAccess: false,
                      allowContentAccess: false,
                      forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
                      algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: false,
                    ),
                    shouldOverrideUrlLoading: (controller, navigationAction) async {
                      final uri = navigationAction.request.url;
                      if (uri == null) return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;

                      return NotebookNavigation.allowed(uri)
                          ? NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW : NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                    },
                    onWebViewCreated: (controller) => _webController = controller,
                    onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) {
                      if (mounted) _loadProgress.value = progress / 100;
                    },
                    onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
                      if (!mounted || url == null) return;
                      final urlStr = url.toString();

                      final cookieManager = CookieManager.instance();
                      final cookies = await cookieManager.getCookies(
                        url: WebUri("https://notebook.google.com"),
                      );
                      final hasSession = cookies.any((c) =>
                          c.name == 'SID' ||
                          c.name == 'HSID' ||
                          c.name == 'SSID' ||
                          c.name == 'OSID');

                      if (hasSession ||
                          (NotebookNavigation.notebook(url) &&
                              !urlStr.contains('ServiceLogin') &&
                              !urlStr.contains('signin'))) {
                        await _onSessionAuthenticated();
                      }
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Full screen view for the research library.

class _LibraryScreenState extends State<LibraryScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final CanonicalLibraryService _service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;
  Timer? _searchDebounce;

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _allBooks;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _filteredBooks;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
    _searchController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchDebounce?.cancel();
    _searchController.removeListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    _searchDebounce?.cancel();
    _searchDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 200), () {
      if (_allBooks == null || !mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _filteredBooks = _service.filterBooks(
          _allBooks!,
          _searchController.text,
        );
      });
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final books = await _service.loadSyafiiCatalog();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allBooks = books;
        _filteredBooks = books;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _errorMessage = 'Katalog rujukan belum dapat dimuat saat ini.';
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

        return SafeArea(

                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
                  Text(

                    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,

                      fontSize: 22,
                      height: 1.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.xs),
                  Text(
                    book.authorArabic,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,

                      height: 1.4,
                    ),

                  if (book.volumesCount != null)

                  if (book.publisher != null && book.publisher!.isNotEmpty)

import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import '../core/routes.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../core/app_snackbar.dart';
import '../services/auth_service.dart';
import '../widgets/apple_interactive_wrapper.dart';

/// LoginScreen: Gerbang Masuk OpenTurath
/// Mengadopsi filosofi desain minimalis modern Claude:
/// - Dark mode hitam pekat (pure deep black)
/// - Light mode putih pekat (pure clean white)
/// - Shape minimalis dengan garis abu-abu tipis (subtle hairline border)
/// - Slogan resmi: "Membaca kitab, menelusuri ibarah." dengan tipografi editorial serif
class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}

class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen> {
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  bool _isLoading = false;
  late final TapGestureRecognizer _termsRecognizer;
  late final TapGestureRecognizer _privacyRecognizer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _termsRecognizer = TapGestureRecognizer()
      ..onTap = () => _openLegalUrl('https://openturath.ai/terms');
    _privacyRecognizer = TapGestureRecognizer()
      ..onTap = () => _openLegalUrl('https://openturath.ai/privacy');
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _termsRecognizer.dispose();
    _privacyRecognizer.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _openLegalUrl(String url) async {
    final uri = Uri.parse(url);
    try {
      if (!await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication)) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.platformDefault);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.error(context, 'Tidak dapat membuka tautan halaman.');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _signIn() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final user = await _authService.signInWithGoogle();
      if (!mounted || user == null) return;
      Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.googleSessionAuth);
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final message = e.toString().contains('network') || e.toString().contains('SocketException')
          ? 'Koneksi internet bermasalah. Periksa jaringan Anda.'
          : 'Gagal masuk akun Google. Silakan coba kembali.';
      AppSnackBar.error(context, message);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Widget _stagger({required int delayMs, required Widget child}) {
    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: 350 + delayMs),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      builder: (context, value, animChild) {
        return Transform.translate(
          offset: Offset(0, 18 * (1 - value)),
          child: Opacity(
            opacity: value.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            child: animChild,
          ),
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const bg = AppTheme.canvasDark;
    const textPrimary = AppTheme.textPrimaryDark;
    const textMuted = AppTheme.textSecondaryDark;

    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
      value: const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
        statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
        statusBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
        systemNavigationBarColor: bg,
        systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
      ),
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: bg,

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class MainShellController extends InheritedWidget {
  final void Function(int index, {String? fieldId, CorpusKind? kind}) switchTab;

  const MainShellController({
    super.key,
    required this.switchTab,
    required super.child,
  });

  static MainShellController? of(BuildContext context) {
    return context.dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType<MainShellController>();
  }

  @override
  bool updateShouldNotify(MainShellController oldWidget) => false;
}

class MainShellScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final int initialTab;

  const MainShellScreen({super.key, this.initialTab = 0});

  @override
  State<MainShellScreen> createState() => _MainShellScreenState();
}

class _MainShellScreenState extends State<MainShellScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late int _currentIndex;
  late final PageController _pageController;
  String? _selectedFieldId;
  CorpusKind? _selectedKind;

  late final AnimationController _roomAnimController;
  late final Animation<Offset> _roomSlideAnimation;
  late final Animation<double> _roomFadeAnimation;
  late final Animation<double> _bgDimmerAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _currentIndex = widget.initialTab;
    _pageController = PageController(initialPage: _currentIndex);

    // Animasi geser vertikal murni nan ringan (240ms) tanpa scale/GPU lag
    _roomAnimController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
      reverseDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
    );

    final CurvedAnimation easeCurve = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _roomAnimController,
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
    );

    _roomSlideAnimation = Tween<Offset>(
      begin: const Offset(0.0, 0.12),
      end: Offset.zero,
    ).animate(easeCurve);

    _roomFadeAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0.0,
      end: 1.0,
    ).animate(easeCurve);

    _bgDimmerAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 0.0,
      end: 0.35,
    ).animate(easeCurve);

    if (AgentSessionManager.instance.isOpen) {
      _roomAnimController.value = 1.0;
    }
    AgentSessionManager.instance.addListener(_onSessionStateChanged);
  }

  void _onSessionStateChanged() {
    final disableAnimations = MediaQuery.maybeOf(context)?.disableAnimations ?? false;
    if (AgentSessionManager.instance.isOpen) {
      if (disableAnimations) {
        _roomAnimController.value = 1.0;
      } else {
        _roomAnimController.forward();
      }
    } else {
      if (disableAnimations) {
        _roomAnimController.value = 0.0;
      } else {
        _roomAnimController.reverse();
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    AgentSessionManager.instance.removeListener(_onSessionStateChanged);
    _roomAnimController.dispose();
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onTabSelected(int index, {String? fieldId, CorpusKind? kind}) {
    if (_pageController.hasClients && _currentIndex != index) {
      _pageController.animateToPage(
        index,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      );
    }
    setState(() {
      _currentIndex = index;
      _selectedFieldId = fieldId;
      _selectedKind = kind;
    });
  }

  List<Widget> _buildScreens() {
    final field = _selectedFieldId != null
        ? FieldModel.defaultFields.firstWhere(
            (f) => f.id == _selectedFieldId,
            orElse: () => FieldModel.defaultFields.first,
          )
        : null;

    return [
      const DashboardScreen(),
      SpecialistListScreen(
        key: ValueKey('${_selectedFieldId}_${_selectedKind?.name}'),
        field: field,
      ),
      const BookmarkScreen(),
      const ProfileScreen(),
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = isDark ? AppTheme.canvasDark : AppTheme.canvasLight;
    final surface = isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
    final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
    final accent = isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight;
    final unselected = isDark ? AppTheme.textTertiaryDark : AppTheme.textTertiaryLight;

    final isWideScreen = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 768;
    final screens = _buildScreens();

    final Widget baseScaffold = isWideScreen
        ? Scaffold(
            backgroundColor: canvas,
            body: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 76,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: surface,
                    border: Border(right: BorderSide(color: border, width: 1)),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      const SizedBox(height: 20),
                      OpenTurathMark(size: 36, color: accent),
                      const SizedBox(height: 32),
                      _RailItem(
                        icon: Icons.home_outlined,
                        activeIcon: Icons.home_rounded,
                        label: AppCopy.navHome,
                        isSelected: _currentIndex == 0,
                        accent: accent,
                        unselected: unselected,
                        onTap: () => _onTabSelected(0),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      _RailItem(
                        icon: Icons.auto_awesome_outlined,
                        activeIcon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                        label: AppCopy.navStudies,
                        isSelected: _currentIndex == 1,
                        accent: accent,
                        unselected: unselected,
                        onTap: () => _onTabSelected(1),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      _RailItem(
                        icon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,
                        activeIcon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,
                        label: AppCopy.navSaved,
                        isSelected: _currentIndex == 2,
                        accent: accent,
                        unselected: unselected,
                        onTap: () => _onTabSelected(2),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      _RailItem(
                        icon: Icons.settings_outlined,
                        activeIcon: Icons.settings_rounded,
                        label: AppCopy.navSettings,
                        isSelected: _currentIndex == 3,
                        accent: accent,
                        unselected: unselected,
                        onTap: () => _onTabSelected(3),
                      ),
                      const Spacer(),
                      IconButton(
                        tooltip: isDark ? 'Beralih ke Tema Terang' : 'Beralih ke Tema Gelap',
                        icon: Icon(
                          isDark ? Icons.light_mode_rounded : Icons.dark_mode_rounded,
                          color: unselected,
                          size: 20,
                        ),
                        onPressed: () {
                          AppConfig.setThemeMode(isDark ? ThemeMode.light : ThemeMode.dark);
                        },
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: PageView(
                    controller: _pageController,
                    physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                    children: screens,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          )
        : Scaffold(
            backgroundColor: canvas,
            body: PageView(
              controller: _pageController,
              physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              children: screens,
            ),
            extendBody: true,
            bottomNavigationBar: Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: surface,
                border: Border(
                  top: BorderSide(
                    color: border,
                    width: 0.8,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              child: SafeArea(
                top: false,
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 64,
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: _GoogleNavBarItem(
                          icon: Icons.home_outlined,
                          activeIcon: Icons.home_rounded,
                          label: AppCopy.navHome,
                          isSelected: _currentIndex == 0,
                          onTap: () => _onTabSelected(0),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Expanded(
                        child: _GoogleNavBarItem(
                          icon: Icons.auto_awesome_outlined,
                          activeIcon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                          label: AppCopy.navStudies,
                          isSelected: _currentIndex == 1,
                          onTap: () => _onTabSelected(1),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Expanded(
                        child: _GoogleNavBarItem(
                          icon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,
                          activeIcon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,
                          label: AppCopy.navSaved,
                          isSelected: _currentIndex == 2,
                          onTap: () => _onTabSelected(2),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Expanded(
                        child: _GoogleNavBarItem(
                          icon: Icons.settings_outlined,
                          activeIcon: Icons.settings_rounded,
                          label: AppCopy.navSettings,
                          isSelected: _currentIndex == 3,
                          onTap: () => _onTabSelected(3),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );

    return MainShellController(
      switchTab: _onTabSelected,
      child: AnimatedBuilder(
        animation: _roomAnimController,
        builder: (context, child) {
          final sessionManager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
          final isRoomVisible = _roomAnimController.value > 0.0 || sessionManager.isOpen;

          return PopScope(
            // OT-F007: canPop hanya diizinkan jika ruang tertutup DAN animasi selesai di-dismiss
            canPop: !sessionManager.isOpen && _roomAnimController.isDismissed && _currentIndex == 0,
            onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
              if (didPop) return;
              // Cegah double-back race saat animasi mundur sedang berjalan
              if (sessionManager.isOpen || !_roomAnimController.isDismissed) {
                sessionManager.closeRoom();
                return;
              }
              if (_currentIndex != 0) {
                _onTabSelected(0);
              }
            },
            child: Stack(
              children: [
                // 1. Dashboard latar belakang (Stationary - bebas GPU overhead rasterisasi)
                baseScaffold,

                // 2. Backdrop Dimmer lembut
                if (_roomAnimController.value > 0.0)
                  Positioned.fill(
                    child: IgnorePointer(
                      ignoring: _roomAnimController.value == 0.0,
                      child: Container(
                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: _bgDimmerAnimation.value),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),

                // 3. Ruang AI Multi-Tab ("Fathul Kitab" - Pure Vertical Slide & Fade)
                Positioned.fill(
                  child: Offstage(
                    offstage: !isRoomVisible,
                    child: TickerMode(
                      enabled: isRoomVisible,
                      child: FadeTransition(
                        opacity: _roomFadeAnimation,
                        child: SlideTransition(
                          position: _roomSlideAnimation,
                          child: child,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
        child: const AgentMultiTabRoom(),
      ),
    );
}
}

class ProfileScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProfileScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ProfileScreen> createState() => _ProfileScreenState();
}

class _ProfileScreenState extends State<ProfileScreen> {
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  bool _isLoggingOut = false;
  bool _isDeletingAccount = false;
  String _appVersion = '1.0.9';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadAppVersion();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAppVersion() async {
    try {
      final info = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _appVersion = '${info.version}+${info.buildNumber}');
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _logout() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
          title: Text(
            AppCopy.logoutDialogTitle,
            style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 18),
          ),
          content: Text(
            AppCopy.logoutDialogBody,
            style: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text('Batal', style: OTTypography.button(color: textSecondary)),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: OTColors.destructive,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
              ),
              child: Text(AppCopy.logoutButton, style: OTTypography.button(color: Colors.white)),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isLoggingOut = true);
    try {
      await _authService.signOut();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(context, AppRoutes.login, (r) => false);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoggingOut = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteAccount() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) {
        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder),
          title: Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded, color: OTColors.destructive, size: 24),
              const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.sm),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  AppCopy.deleteAccountTitle,
                  style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: OTColors.destructive).copyWith(fontSize: 18),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          content: Text(
            AppCopy.deleteAccountBody,
            style: OTTypography.body(color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark)),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
              child: Text('Batal', style: OTTypography.button(color: OTColors.textSecondary(isDark))),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: OTColors.destructive,
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: OTRadius.buttonBorder),
              ),
              child: Text(AppCopy.deleteAccountButton, style: OTTypography.button(color: Colors.white)),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isDeletingAccount = true);
    try {
      await _authService.deleteAccount();
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.deleteAccountSuccess);
        Navigator.pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(context, AppRoutes.login, (r) => false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isDeletingAccount = false);
        final errText = e.toString().contains('requires-recent-login')
            ? AppCopy.recentLoginRequired
            : AppCopy.networkError;
        AppSnackBar.error(context, errText);
      }
    }
  }

  bool _isOpeningSubscription = false;

  Future<void> _openSubscription() async {
    if (_isOpeningSubscription) return;
    _isOpeningSubscription = true;
    try {
      final user = await _authService.getCurrentUserModel();
      if (!mounted) return;

      await NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
        context,
        AppRoutes.subscription,
        arguments: {
          'user': user,
          'agent': AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere(
            (a) => a.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat',
            orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
          ),
        },
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isOpeningSubscription = false);
      } else {
        _isOpeningSubscription = false;
      }
    }
  }

            final userModel = snapshot.data;

            final displayName = userModel?.name.isNotEmpty == true
                ? userModel!.name

            final email = userModel?.email.isNotEmpty == true
                ? userModel!.email
                : (fbUser?.email ?? 'pengguna@openturath.id');
            final plan = userModel?.plan ?? 'trial';
            final isSubscribed =
                userModel?.isSubscriptionActive ?? (userModel?.isPremium ?? false);

            final exp = userModel?.subscriptionExpiry;
            const months = [
              '',
              'Januari',
              'Februari',
              'Maret',
              'April',
              'Mei',
              'Juni',
              'Juli',
              'Agustus',
              'September',
              'Oktober',
              'November',
              'Desember'
            ];
            final expStr = exp != null
                ? ' · Aktif hingga ${exp.day} ${months[exp.month]} ${exp.year}'
                : '';
            final String subscriptionSubtitle;

            if (isSubscribed) {
              final isAllAccess = plan == 'sultan' ||
                  plan == 'all_access' ||
                  plan == 'all_ai_1m' ||
                  plan == 'all_ai_6m' ||
                  plan == 'all_ai_1y' ||
                  plan == 'all_ai' ||
                  (userModel?.entitlements['all_access']?.isActive ?? false);

              if (isAllAccess) {
                subscriptionSubtitle = 'Akses semua bidang$expStr';
              } else if (plan == 'field') {
                subscriptionSubtitle = 'Paket per bidang$expStr';
              } else if (plan == 'single') {
                subscriptionSubtitle = 'Akses satu bidang$expStr';
              } else {
                subscriptionSubtitle = '${AppCopy.activeSubscription}$expStr';
              }
            } else {
              subscriptionSubtitle = AppCopy.inactiveSubscription;
            }

            return ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 108),
              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),

                    color: surface,

                  ),

                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 16),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              width: 44,
                              height: 44,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: isDark
                                    ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08)

                              ),
                              alignment: Alignment.center,
                              child: Icon(Icons.person_outline_rounded, size: 22, color: textPrimary),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 14),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    displayName,

                                      fontSize: 16,

                                    maxLines: 1,
                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,

                                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                  Text(

  Widget _buildThemeOption({
    required String title,
    required IconData icon,
    required bool isSelected,
    required bool isDark,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    final activeBg = isDark ? const Color(0xFF18181B) : Colors.white;
    final activeFg = isDark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF18181B);
    final inactiveFg = textSecondary;

    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: () {
          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
          onTap();
        },
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? activeBg : Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),
            boxShadow: isSelected
                ? [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.06),
                      blurRadius: 4,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                    ),
                  ]
                : null,
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 15, color: isSelected ? activeFg : inactiveFg),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Text(
                title,
                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w500,
                  color: isSelected ? activeFg : inactiveFg,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _SettingsTile extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final Widget? trailing;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  const _SettingsTile({
    required this.icon,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    this.trailing,
    this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    return AppleInteractiveWrapper(
      onTap: onTap,
      pressedScale: 0.985,
      hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.light,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      child: ListTile(
        onTap: onTap,
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.base, vertical: 2),
        leading: Icon(
          icon,
          size: 21,
          color: textPrimary,
        ),
        title: Text(
          title,
          style: OTTypography.bodyMedium(color: textPrimary),
        ),
        subtitle: Text(
          subtitle,
          style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
        ),
        trailing: trailing,
      ),
    );
  }
}
