```dart
import 'main_shell_screen.dart';

class SpecialistListScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final FieldModel? field; // Nullable if opened as general Specialist tab

  const SpecialistListScreen({super.key, this.field});

  @override
  State<SpecialistListScreen> createState() => _SpecialistListScreenState();
}

class _SpecialistListScreenState extends State<SpecialistListScreen> {
  final AgentService _agentService = AgentService();
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  Timer? _debounce;

  List<AgentModel> _allAgents = [];
  String? _selectedFieldId;
  String _searchQuery = '';
  bool _isLoading = true;
  CorpusKind _corpusKind = CorpusKind.discipline;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selectedFieldId = widget.field?.id;
    _loadAgents();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    _debounce?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAgents() async {
    try {
      final agents = await _agentService.getAgents();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _allAgents = agents;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _allAgents = AgentModel.defaultAgents;
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _onSearchChanged(String val) {
    if (_debounce?.isActive ?? false) _debounce!.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 250), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _searchQuery = val.trim();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  List<AgentModel> _computeFilteredAgents() {
    return _allAgents.where((agent) {
      // 1. Filter by CorpusKind
      if (agent.kind != _corpusKind) return false;

      // 2. Filter by discipline field if in discipline mode
      if (_corpusKind == CorpusKind.discipline) {
        final matchesField = _selectedFieldId == null ||
            _selectedFieldId == 'all' ||
            agent.fieldId == _selectedFieldId;
        if (!matchesField) return false;
      }

      // 3. Filter by search query
      if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) return true;

      return ArabicUtils.matches(agent.title, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.titleArabic, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.subtitleAcademic, _searchQuery) ||
          ArabicUtils.matches(agent.description, _searchQuery);
    }).toList();
  }

  void _openAgent(AgentModel agent) {
    OTMotion.light();
    if (agent.isComingSoon) {
      AppSnackBar.warning(
        context,
        '${agent.title} sedang disiapkan.',
      );
      return;
    }

    final user = _authService.cachedCurrentUser;
    if (user != null && !user.hasAccessToAgent(agent.id)) {
      _openSubscriptionForAgent(agent);
      return;
    }

    AgentSessionManager.instance.openAgent(agent, user: user);
  }

  bool _isOpeningSubscription = false;

  void _openSubscriptionForAgent(AgentModel agent) {
    if (_isOpeningSubscription) return;
    _isOpeningSubscription = true;

    _authService.getCurrentUserModel().then((user) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
        context,
        AppRoutes.subscription,
        arguments: {'agent': agent, 'user': user},
      );
    }).whenComplete(() {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isOpeningSubscription = false);
      } else {
        _isOpeningSubscription = false;
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    final isGeneralTab = widget.field == null;
    final title = isGeneralTab ? 'Asisten AI' : widget.field!.name;
    final filtered = _computeFilteredAgents();

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
        if (didPop) return;
        final shell = MainShellController.of(context);
        if (shell != null) {
          shell.switchTab(0);
        } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
          Navigator.pop(context);
        }
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(
            title,
            style: OTTypography.corpusTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 20),
          ),
          centerTitle: false,
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          elevation: 0,
          scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
          leading: isGeneralTab
              ? null
              : IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded, color: textPrimary),
                  onPressed: () {
                    final shell = MainShellController.of(context);
                    if (shell != null) {
                      shell.switchTab(0);
                    } else if (Navigator.canPop(context)) {
                      Navigator.pop(context);
                    }
                  },
                ),
        ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // Search & Controls Container
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.lg, vertical: OTSpacing.sm),
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    height: 48,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: surface,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                      border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1.0),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                            controller: _searchCtrl,
                            onChanged: _onSearchChanged,
                            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 13.5, color: textPrimary),
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              hintText: 'Cari asisten, kitab, atau bab…',
                              hintStyle: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 13.5, color: textSecondary),
                              border: InputBorder.none,
                              enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                              focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                              disabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                              errorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                              focusedErrorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                              filled: false,
                              isDense: true,
                              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty)
                          GestureDetector(
                            onTap: () {
                              _searchCtrl.clear();
                              setState(() => _searchQuery = '');
                            },
                            child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),

                  if (isGeneralTab) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.md),
                    // Dual Taxonomy Switcher
                    CorpusKindControl(
                      value: _corpusKind,
                      onChanged: (k) {
                        setState(() {
                          _corpusKind = k;
                          _selectedFieldId = null;
                        });
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Discipline Filter Chips (only in discipline mode)
            if (isGeneralTab && _corpusKind == CorpusKind.discipline) ...[
              SizedBox(
                height: 38,
                child: ListView(
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: OTSpacing.lg),
                  children: [
                    _filterChip(
                      label: 'Semua Bidang',
                      isSelected: _selectedFieldId == null || _selectedFieldId == 'all',
                      onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedFieldId = 'all'),
                      isDark: isDark,
                      border: border,
                      surface: surface,
                      textPrimary: textPrimary,
                      textSecondary: textSecondary,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    ...FieldModel.defaultFields.map((field) {
                      return Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                        child: _filterChip(
                          label: field.name,
                          isSelected: _selectedFieldId == field.id,
                          onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedFieldId = field.id),
                          isDark: isDark,
                          border: border,
                          surface: surface,
                          textPrimary: textPrimary,
                          textSecondary: textSecondary,
                        ),
                      );
                    }),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
            ],

            // Content List
            Expanded(
              child: _isLoading
                  ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
                  : filtered.isEmpty
                      ? Center(
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(OTSpacing.xl),
                            child: Column(
                              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                              children: [
                                Icon(Icons.search_off_rounded, size: 40, color: textSecondary),
                                const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),
                                Text(
                                  _searchQuery.isNotEmpty
                                      ? 'Belum ada asisten atau kitab yang cocok. Coba kata kunci lain.'
                                      : 'Belum ada asisten di kategori ini.',
                                  style: OTTypography.body(color: textSecondary),
                                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        )
                      : Builder(
                          builder: (context) {
                            final sorted = List<AgentModel>.from(filtered);
                            if (_searchQuery.isEmpty) {
                              sorted.sort((a, b) {
                                if (a.isActive && !b.isActive) return -1;
                                if (!a.isActive && b.isActive) return 1;
                                return 0;
                              });
                            }

                            return ListView.separated(
                              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(parent: AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics()),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(OTSpacing.lg, OTSpacing.xs, OTSpacing.lg, 96),
                              itemCount: sorted.length,
                              separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 12),
                              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                                final agent = sorted[index];
                                return SpecialistCard(
                                  title: agent.title,
                                  statusLabel: agent.isComingSoon ? 'Segera hadir' : null,
                                  onOpen: () => _openAgent(agent),
                                  onOpenLibrary: agent.catalogId != null
                                      ? () => showResearchLibrary(context, agent: agent)
                                      : null,
                                );
                              },
                            );
                          },
                        ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

  Widget _filterChip({
    required String label,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    required bool isDark,
    required Color border,
    required Color surface,
    required Color textPrimary,
    required Color textSecondary,
  }) {
    final activeBg = textPrimary;
    final activeFg = isDark ? Colors.black : Colors.white;

    return AppleInteractiveWrapper(
      onTap: onTap,
      pressedScale: 0.94,
      hapticType: HapticFeedbackType.selection,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected ? activeBg : surface,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected ? activeBg : border,
            width: 0.8,
          ),
        ),
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: OTTypography.caption(color: isSelected ? activeFg : textSecondary).copyWith(
            fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w500,
            fontSize: 12,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../core/routes.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../widgets/app_loader.dart';

class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    _controller = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 450),
      vsync: this,
    );

    _fadeAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeOut),
    );

    _scaleAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.95, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic),
    );

    _controller.forward();
    _checkAuthAndNavigate();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _checkAuthAndNavigate() async {
    try {
      final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
      String targetRoute;

      if (user != null && !user.isAnonymous) {
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance()
            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
        final isSessionReady = prefs.getBool('google_session_ready') ?? false;
        if (!isSessionReady) {
          targetRoute = AppRoutes.googleSessionAuth;
        } else {
          targetRoute = AppRoutes.dashboard;
        }
      } else {
        targetRoute = AppRoutes.login;
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, targetRoute);
    } catch (_) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pushReplacementNamed(context, AppRoutes.login);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const bg = AppTheme.canvasDark;
    const textPrimary = AppTheme.textPrimaryDark;
    const accent = AppTheme.textSecondaryDark;

    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(
      value: const SystemUiOverlayStyle(
        statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,
        statusBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
        systemNavigationBarColor: bg,
        systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light,
      ),
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: bg,
        body: Center(
          child: FadeTransition(
            opacity: _fadeAnimation,
            child: ScaleTransition(
              scale: _scaleAnimation,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'OpenTurath',
                    style: GoogleFonts.newsreader(
                      fontSize: 32,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      letterSpacing: -0.6,
                      color: textPrimary,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 28),
                  const AppLoader(color: accent, dotSize: 7, spacing: 3.5),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../core/app_copy.dart';

/// Halaman Langganan OpenTurath (Quiet Scholar Adaptive)
class SubscriptionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SubscriptionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SubscriptionScreen> createState() => _SubscriptionScreenState();
}

class _SubscriptionScreenState extends State<SubscriptionScreen> {
  final SubscriptionService _subService = SubscriptionService();
  UserModel? _user;
  AgentModel? _agent;
  bool _isProcessing = false;
  int _selectedDurationIndex = 0; // 0: 1 Bulan, 1: 6 Bulan, 2: 1 Tahun

  List<AgentModel> get _activeAgents =>
      AgentModel.defaultAgents.where((a) => a.isActive).toList();

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    if (_user == null) {
      final args = ModalRoute.of(context)?.settings.arguments;
      if (args is UserModel) {
        _user = args;
      } else if (args is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        _user = args['user'] as UserModel?;
        _agent = args['agent'] as AgentModel?;
      }

      final fbUser = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
      if (_user == null && fbUser != null) {
        _user = UserModel(
          uid: fbUser.uid,
          email: fbUser.email ?? '',
          name: fbUser.displayName ??
              (fbUser.email?.split('@').first ?? 'Santri Peneliti'),
          photoUrl: fbUser.photoURL ?? '',
          plan: 'trial',
          questionsUsed: 0,
        );
      }

      _agent ??= AgentModel.defaultAgents.firstWhere(
        (a) => a.id == 'fiqh_tahawwulat',
        orElse: () => AgentModel.defaultAgents.first,
      );
      if (_agent != null && _agent!.isComingSoon && _activeAgents.isNotEmpty) {
        _agent = _activeAgents.first;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<String?> _getOrPromptPhone() async {
    final uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null) return null;
    final phoneKey = 'openturath_${uid}_user_phone';
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final saved = prefs.getString(phoneKey) ?? '';
      if (saved.isNotEmpty && saved.length >= 8) {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    if (!mounted) return null;
    final textController = TextEditingController();
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    String? phone;
    try {
      phone = await showDialog<String>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: OTRadius.dialogBorder,
            side: BorderSide(color: border, width: 0.8),
          ),
          title: Text(
            'Nomor WhatsApp',
            style: OTTypography.cardTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 17),
          ),
          content: Column(

              TextField(

            ),
          ],

    } finally {
      textController.dispose();
    }

    if (phone != null && phone.isNotEmpty) {

    return phone;

  Future<void> _handleSubscribe({
    required String plan,
    required String planTitle,
    required int price,
    AgentModel? targetAgent,
  }) async {
    final fbUser = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (_user == null && fbUser != null) {
      _user = UserModel(
        uid: fbUser.uid,
        email: fbUser.email ?? '',
        name: fbUser.displayName ?? 'Santri Peneliti',
        photoUrl: fbUser.photoURL ?? '',
        plan: 'trial',
        questionsUsed: 0,
      );
    }

    if (_user == null) {
      AppSnackBar.warning(
        context,
        'Silakan masuk akun terlebih dahulu untuk berlangganan.',
      );
      return;
    }

    final phone = await _getOrPromptPhone();
    if (phone == null || phone.isEmpty) return;

    final currentAgent = targetAgent ?? _agent;

    setState(() {
      _isProcessing = true;
    });

    String? dokuUrl;
    String invoiceNumber = '';
    String trxId = '';

    try {
      final userName = _user!.name.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? _user!.name.trim()
          : (_user!.email.isNotEmpty ? _user!.email.split('@').first : 'Santri Peneliti');

      final result = await _subService
          .createPayment(
            uid: _user!.uid,
            agentId: currentAgent?.id ?? 'all_ai',
            plan: plan,
            planTitle: planTitle,
            amount: price,
            name: userName,
            email: _user!.email,
            phone: phone,
          )
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));

      final redirectUrl = result['redirectUrl'] as String?;
      invoiceNumber = (result['invoiceNumber'] as String?) ?? '';
      trxId = (result['trxId'] as String?) ?? '';
      if (redirectUrl != null && redirectUrl.isNotEmpty) {
        dokuUrl = redirectUrl;
      } else {
        throw Exception('DOKU PG tidak mengembalikan URL pembayaran valid');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      AppSnackBar.error(
        context,
        'Terjadi kendala saat menyiapkan sesi pembayaran. Periksa koneksi internet Anda lalu coba kembali.',
      );
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isProcessing = false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final isPaid = await DokuCheckoutSheet.show(
        context,
        paymentUrl: dokuUrl,
        invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber,
        trxId: trxId,
        planTitle: planTitle,
        amount: price,
      );

      if (isPaid == true) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        AppSnackBar.success(
          context,
          'Pembayaran berhasil. Akses sudah aktif.',
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
        );
        Navigator.pop(context);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      AppSnackBar.error(
        context,
        'Tidak dapat membuka sesi pembayaran saat ini. Silakan coba kembali.',
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isProcessing = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final surfaceSubtle = OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    final activeList = _activeAgents;

    // Pricing tiers untuk AI Spesialis Terpilih
    final moduleTiers = [
      {'name': '1 Bulan', 'price': 49000, 'label': 'Rp 49.000', 'period': '/ bulan', 'planId': AppConstants.planTholib1m},
      {'name': '6 Bulan', 'price': 299000, 'label': 'Rp 299.000', 'period': '/ 6 bulan', 'planId': AppConstants.planTholib6m},
      {'name': '1 Tahun', 'price': 499000, 'label': 'Rp 499.000', 'period': '/ tahun', 'planId': AppConstants.planBahits1y},
    ];
```

```dart
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';

class AgentService {
  final FirebaseFunctions _functions = FirebaseFunctions.instance;

  // ── Ambil daftar semua agent dari Firestore / model lokal ────
  Future<List<AgentModel>> getAgents() async {
    return AgentModel.defaultAgents;
  }

  // ── Ambil URL agent dari Cloud Function secara aman (Server-Side Entitlement) ────
  Future<String?> getAgentUrl(String agentId) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable(AppConstants.fnGetAgentUrl);
      final result = await callable.call({'agentId': agentId});
      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data);
      final url = data['url'] as String?;
      if (url != null && url.isNotEmpty) {
        return url;
      }
      throw const AgentAccessException('empty-url', 'URL asisten belum tersedia untuk bidang ini.');
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == 'permission-denied') {
        throw AgentAccessException(
          'permission-denied',
          e.message ?? 'Langganan diperlukan untuk membuka asisten ini.',
        );
      }
      throw AgentAccessException(e.code, e.message ?? 'Tidak dapat terhubung ke server.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is AgentAccessException) rethrow;
      throw AgentAccessException('unknown-error', e.toString());
    }
  }

  // ── Catat pertanyaan trial secara atomik di Cloud Functions ───
  Future<TrialUsage> recordQuestion(String agentId) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable('recordQuestion');
      final result = await callable.call({'agentId': agentId});
      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data);
      return TrialUsage(
        isPremium: data['isPremium'] == true,
        questionsUsed: (data['questionsUsed'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
        questionsRemaining: (data['questionsRemaining'] as num?)?.toInt(),
      );
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      throw AgentAccessException(e.code, e.message ?? 'Gagal mencatat kuota pertanyaan.');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e is AgentAccessException) rethrow;
      throw AgentAccessException('record-error', e.toString());
    }
  }
}

class TrialUsage {
  const TrialUsage({
    required this.isPremium,
    required this.questionsUsed,
    required this.questionsRemaining,
  });

  final bool isPremium;
  final int questionsUsed;
  final int? questionsRemaining;
}

class AgentAccessException implements Exception {
  const AgentAccessException(this.code, this.message);
  final String code;
  final String message;

  @override
  String toString() => 'AgentAccessException($code): $message';
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';
import '../models/agent_model.dart';
import '../models/user_model.dart';

/// Represents a single active AI specialist tab in memory.
class AgentSessionTab {
  final AgentModel agent;
  String? resolvedUrl;
  InAppWebViewController? webController;
  bool isUrlLoading = true;
  bool isWebLoading = true;
  String? errorMessage;
  bool isPaywallRequired = false;
  double fontScale = 1.0;
  bool hasAcknowledgedAdab = false;

  AgentSessionTab({
    required this.agent,
    this.resolvedUrl,
  });
}

/// AgentSessionManager: Singleton state manager for multi-tab AI study sessions.
/// Keeps up to 7 specialists loaded in background memory like Google Chrome tabs.
class AgentSessionManager extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final AgentSessionManager instance = AgentSessionManager._();
  AgentSessionManager._();

  static const int maxTabs = 7;

  final List<AgentSessionTab> _tabs = [];
  int _activeIndex = 0;
  bool _isOpen = false;

  List<AgentSessionTab> get tabs => List.unmodifiable(_tabs);
  int get activeIndex => _activeIndex;
  bool get isOpen => _isOpen;
  bool get hasSessions => _tabs.isNotEmpty;

  AgentSessionTab? get activeTab {
    if (_tabs.isEmpty || _activeIndex < 0 || _activeIndex >= _tabs.length) {
      return null;
    }
    return _tabs[_activeIndex];
  }

  /// Open an agent or switch to its existing active tab with zero reload.
  void openAgent(AgentModel agent, {UserModel? user}) {
    final existingIndex = _tabs.indexWhere((t) => t.agent.id == agent.id);
    if (existingIndex != -1) {
      _activeIndex = existingIndex;
    } else {
      if (_tabs.length >= maxTabs) {
        // Tab limit reached: close oldest non-active tab to preserve WebView memory
        final evictIndex = _activeIndex == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        closeTab(evictIndex);
      }
      _tabs.add(AgentSessionTab(agent: agent));
      _activeIndex = _tabs.length - 1;
    }
    _isOpen = true;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Switch active tab (like clicking a Chrome tab).
  void selectTab(int index) {
    if (index >= 0 && index < _tabs.length && _activeIndex != index) {
      _activeIndex = index;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  /// Close a specific tab with the 'x' button.
  void closeTab(int index) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= _tabs.length) return;

    try {
      _tabs[index].webController?.stopLoading();
    } catch (_) {}

    _tabs.removeAt(index);

    if (_tabs.isEmpty) {
      _isOpen = false;
      _activeIndex = 0;
    } else if (index < _activeIndex) {
      _activeIndex--;
    } else if (_activeIndex >= _tabs.length) {
      _activeIndex = _tabs.length - 1;
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Hide the AI study room to return to the Dashboard while keeping all WebViews alive.
  void closeRoom() {
    _isOpen = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Reset all sessions (e.g. on user logout).
  void closeAll() {
    for (final tab in _tabs) {
      try {
        tab.webController?.stopLoading();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    _tabs.clear();
    _activeIndex = 0;
    _isOpen = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
```

```dart
class AuthService {
  final FirebaseAuth _auth = FirebaseAuth.instance;
  final GoogleSignIn _googleSignIn = GoogleSignIn(
    serverClientId: '255541559800-jcip3mf8umtscgf5jm8khflm4u83rmcj.apps.googleusercontent.com',
  );
  final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  // Cached persistent userStream to prevent memory leak and listener churn (F10)
  Stream<UserModel?>? _cachedUserStream;

  // In-memory cache to prevent entitlement loss on network hiccup (F41)
  static final Map<String, UserModel> _userCache = {};

  // ── Cache Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  static Future<void> _cacheUserLocally(UserModel user) async {
    _userCache[user.uid] = user;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(
        'openturath_cached_user_${user.uid}',
        jsonEncode(user.toJsonMap()),
      );
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  static Future<UserModel?> _getCachedUser(String uid) async {
    if (_userCache.containsKey(uid)) {
      return _userCache[uid];
    }
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final raw = prefs.getString('openturath_cached_user_$uid');
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final map = jsonDecode(raw) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final user = UserModel.fromMap(uid, map);
        _userCache[uid] = user;
        return user;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }

  // ── Current Firebase User ──────────────────────────────────────
  User? get currentUser => _auth.currentUser;
  Stream<User?> get authStateChanges => _auth.authStateChanges();

  UserModel? get cachedCurrentUser {
    final user = _auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return null;
    return _userCache[user.uid] ??
        UserModel(
          uid: user.uid,

    if (user == null) return null;
    try {
      final doc = await _db
          .collection(AppConstants.colUsers)
          .doc(user.uid)
          .get()
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
      if (!doc.exists) {

  Stream<UserModel?> get userStream => _cachedUserStream ??= _buildUserStream();

    auth: _auth.authStateChanges().map((user) => user?.uid),
    cached: _getCachedUser,
    watch: (uid) => _db.collection(AppConstants.colUsers).doc(uid).snapshots().map((doc) {
      if (!doc.exists) return null;
      final user = UserModel.fromFirestore(doc);
      if (_auth.currentUser?.uid == uid) { unawaited(_cacheUserLocally(user)); }
      return user;
    }),
  );

  // ── Sign Out ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Future<void> signOut() async {
    final currentUid = _auth.currentUser?.uid;

    try {
      final cookieManager = CookieManager.instance();
      await cookieManager.deleteAllCookies();
      await cookieManager.removeSessionCookies();
      await InAppWebViewController.clearAllCache();
      await WebStorageManager.instance().deleteAllData();
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
      await _googleSignIn.signOut();
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.remove('google_session_ready');
      await prefs.remove('last_opened_notebook_id');
      if (currentUid != null) {
        _userCache.remove(currentUid);
        await prefs.remove('openturath_cached_user_$currentUid');
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // Propagate Auth signOut to avoid half-signed-out UI state (F41)
    await _auth.signOut();
  }

  // ── Increment Question Count ───────────────────────────────────
  Future<void> incrementQuestionCount() async {
    final user = currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    try {
      await _db.collection(AppConstants.colUsers).doc(user.uid).update({
        'questions_used': FieldValue.increment(1),
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // ── Delete Account & User Data (Google Play Compliance & Orphan Cleanup, P0) ──
  Future<void> deleteAccount() async {
    final user = currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    final uid = user.uid;

    // Auth deletion enforces recent login. The server trigger owns revocation and recursive cleanup.
    await user.delete();
    try {
      await CookieManager.instance().deleteAllCookies();
      await InAppWebViewController.clearAllCache();
      await WebStorageManager.instance().deleteAllData();
    } catch (_) {}

    // 4. Bersihkan ONLY preferensi spesifik user UID ini (F08 & F41: dilarang prefs.clear())
    try {
      _userCache.remove(uid);
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final keys = prefs.getKeys();
      for (final key in keys) {
        if (key.startsWith('openturath_${uid}_') ||
            key == 'openturath_cached_user_$uid' ||
            key == 'google_session_ready' ||
            key == 'last_opened_notebook_id') {
          await prefs.remove(key);
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 5. Putuskan hubungan Google Sign In
    try {
      await _googleSignIn.disconnect();
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        await _googleSignIn.signOut();
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 6. Pastikan sign-out bersih
    try {
      await _auth.signOut();
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../models/bookmark_model.dart';
import 'scoped_json_store.dart';

class BookmarkService extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final BookmarkService _instance = BookmarkService._internal();
  factory BookmarkService({FirebaseFirestore? firestore, FirebaseAuth? auth}) {
    if (firestore != null) _instance._firestore = firestore;
    if (auth != null) _instance._auth = auth;
    return _instance;
  }
  BookmarkService._internal() {
    _initAuthListener();
  }

  FirebaseFirestore? _firestore;
  FirebaseAuth? _auth;
  bool _isSyncing = false;
  bool get isSyncing => _isSyncing;

  FirebaseAuth? get _activeAuth {
    if (_auth != null) return _auth;
    try {
      return FirebaseAuth.instance;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  FirebaseFirestore? get _db {
    if (_firestore != null) return _firestore;
    try {
      return FirebaseFirestore.instance;
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  void _initAuthListener() {
    try {
      _activeAuth?.authStateChanges().listen((user) {
        if (user != null && user.uid.isNotEmpty) {
          syncWithCloud(userId: user.uid);
        }
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  final _store = ScopedJsonListStore<BookmarkModel>(
    storage: PreferencesStringStore(),
    decode: BookmarkModel.fromJson,
    encode: (bookmark) => bookmark.toJson(),
  );

  static const String _legacyKey = 'openturath_saved_bookmarks';

  String _key(String? userId) {
    final uid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    return uid == null || uid.isEmpty ? _legacyKey : 'openturath_${uid}_saved_bookmarks';
  }

  Future<List<BookmarkModel>> getBookmarks({String? userId}) => _store.read(_key(userId));

  Future<void> saveAll(List<BookmarkModel> bookmarks, {String? userId}) async {
    final key = _key(userId);
    await _store.replace(key, bookmarks);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> addBookmark(BookmarkModel bookmark, {String? userId}) async {
    final effectiveUid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    final key = _key(effectiveUid);

    // 1. Instant local offline-first update
    await _store.update(key, (items) {
      items.removeWhere((item) => item.id == bookmark.id);
      items.insert(0, bookmark);
      return items;
    });
    notifyListeners();

    // 2. Asynchronous cloud push if logged in
    if (effectiveUid != null && effectiveUid.isNotEmpty) {
      unawaited(_pushToCloud(bookmark, effectiveUid));
    }
  }

  Future<void> deleteBookmark(String id, {String? userId}) async {
    final effectiveUid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    final key = _key(effectiveUid);

    // 1. Instant local update
    await _store.update(key, (items) => items..removeWhere((item) => item.id == id));
    notifyListeners();

    // 2. Asynchronous cloud deletion
    if (effectiveUid != null && effectiveUid.isNotEmpty) {
      unawaited(_deleteFromCloud(id, effectiveUid));
    }
  }

  Future<bool> isBookmarked(String id, {String? userId}) async =>
      (await getBookmarks(userId: userId)).any((item) => item.id == id);

  Future<void> _pushToCloud(BookmarkModel bookmark, String uid) async {
    final db = _db;
    if (db == null) return;
    try {
      await db
          .collection('users')
          .doc(uid)
          .collection('bookmarks')
          .doc(bookmark.id)
          .set(bookmark.toJson(), SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      // Offline or network glitch; will be reconciled during next sync
      debugPrint('[BookmarkService] Cloud push skipped/failed: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteFromCloud(String id, String uid) async {
    final db = _db;
    if (db == null) return;
    try {
      await db
          .collection('users')
          .doc(uid)
          .collection('bookmarks')
          .doc(id)
          .delete();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[BookmarkService] Cloud delete skipped/failed: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Bidirectional smart synchronization between local storage and Firestore.
  /// Reconciles differences, migrates legacy offline notes, and ensures zero data loss.
  Future<void> syncWithCloud({String? userId}) async {
    final effectiveUid = userId ?? _activeAuth?.currentUser?.uid;
    if (effectiveUid == null || effectiveUid.isEmpty) return;

    if (_isSyncing) return;
    _isSyncing = true;

    try {
      final userKey = _key(effectiveUid);

      // Step 1: Migrate legacy anonymous notes if any exist
      final legacyNotes = await _store.read(_legacyKey);
      if (legacyNotes.isNotEmpty) {
        final current = await _store.read(userKey);
        final mergedLocal = <String, BookmarkModel>{
          for (final b in current) b.id: b,
        };
        for (final b in legacyNotes) {
          mergedLocal.putIfAbsent(b.id, () => b);
        }
        await _store.replace(userKey, mergedLocal.values.toList());
        await _store.replace(_legacyKey, <BookmarkModel>[]);
        notifyListeners();
      }

      final db = _db;
      if (db == null) {
        return;
      }

      // Step 2: Read current local items
      final localItems = await _store.read(userKey);
      final localMap = <String, BookmarkModel>{
        for (final b in localItems) b.id: b,
      };

      // Step 3: Fetch cloud bookmarks
      final snapshot = await db
          .collection('users')
          .doc(effectiveUid)
          .collection('bookmarks')
          .get();

      final cloudMap = <String, BookmarkModel>{};
      for (final doc in snapshot.docs) {
        try {
          final data = doc.data();
          if (!data.containsKey('id') || (data['id'] as String).isEmpty) {
            data['id'] = doc.id;
          }
          final model = BookmarkModel.fromJson(data);
          cloudMap[model.id] = model;
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      // Step 4: Two-way reconciliation
      // - Push any local notes not yet on cloud
      for (final entry in localMap.entries) {
        if (!cloudMap.containsKey(entry.key)) {
          unawaited(_pushToCloud(entry.value, effectiveUid));
        }
      }

      // - Merge cloud into local
      final merged = <String, BookmarkModel>{...localMap};
      for (final entry in cloudMap.entries) {
        final existing = merged[entry.key];
        if (existing == null || entry.value.createdAt.isAfter(existing.createdAt)) {
          merged[entry.key] = entry.value;
        }
      }

      final finalList = merged.values.toList()
        ..sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.compareTo(a.createdAt));

      await _store.replace(userKey, finalList);
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[BookmarkService] syncWithCloud failed: $e');
    } finally {
      _isSyncing = false;
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
/// Service to load, cache, and search canonical book catalogs with diacritic-tolerant Arabic search.
class CanonicalLibraryService {
  CanonicalLibraryService._();
  static final CanonicalLibraryService instance = CanonicalLibraryService._();

  static const Map<String, String> _assetMapByField = {
    'fiqh': 'assets/data/01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json',
    'hadith': 'assets/data/02_KATALOG_HADITS_DAN_SYARAH.json',

  };

  static const Map<String, String> _assetMapByAgentId = {
    'fiqh_syafii': 'assets/data/01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json',
    'hadits': 'assets/data/02_KATALOG_HADITS_DAN_SYARAH.json',
    'ushul_fiqh': 'assets/data/03_KATALOG_USHUL_FIKIH.json',
    'nahwu_sharaf': 'assets/data/04_KATALOG_BAHASA_DAN_SASTRA_ARAB.json',
    'tafsir': 'assets/data/05_KATALOG_TAFSIR_DAN_ULUMUL_QURAN.json',
    'fiqh_tahawwulat': 'assets/data/06_KATALOG_FIKIH_TAHAWWULAT.json',
  };

  static const Map<String, String> _assetMapByCatalogId = {
    'canonical_syafii': 'assets/data/01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json',
    'canonical_hadits': 'assets/data/02_KATALOG_HADITS_DAN_SYARAH.json',
    'canonical_ushul_fikih': 'assets/data/03_KATALOG_USHUL_FIKIH.json',
    'canonical_bahasa_arab': 'assets/data/04_KATALOG_BAHASA_DAN_SASTRA_ARAB.json',
    'canonical_tafsir': 'assets/data/05_KATALOG_TAFSIR_DAN_ULUMUL_QURAN.json',
    'canonical_tahawwulat': 'assets/data/06_KATALOG_FIKIH_TAHAWWULAT.json',
  };

  final Map<String, List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> _catalogCache = {};

  CanonicalImport? _syafiiCatalog;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _syafiiPresentations;

  /// Normalizes Arabic text by stripping diacritics and unifying letter variants.
  static String normalizeArabic(String text) => ArabicUtils.normalize(text);

  /// Loads catalog for a specific agent or discipline.
  Future<List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> loadCatalogForAgent(AgentModel agent) async {
    final assetPath = (agent.catalogId != null ? _assetMapByCatalogId[agent.catalogId!] : null) ??
        _assetMapByAgentId[agent.id] ??
        _assetMapByField[agent.fieldId];
    if (assetPath == null) {
      if (agent.fieldId == 'fiqh') {
        return loadCatalogFromAsset('assets/data/01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json');
      }
      return [];
    }
    return loadCatalogFromAsset(assetPath);
  }

  /// Loads catalog by discipline field ID (fiqh, hadith, usul, lughah, tafsir, fiqh_tahawwulat).
  Future<List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> loadCatalogByField(String fieldId) async {
    final assetPath = _assetMapByField[fieldId];
    if (assetPath == null) return [];
    return loadCatalogFromAsset(assetPath);
  }

  /// Loads catalog from asset bundle with in-memory caching.
  Future<List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> loadCatalogFromAsset(String assetPath) async {
    if (_catalogCache.containsKey(assetPath)) {
      return _catalogCache[assetPath]!;
    }

    try {
      final jsonStr = await rootBundle.loadString(assetPath);
      final books = parseSyamilahCatalog(jsonStr);
      _catalogCache[assetPath] = books;
      if (assetPath.contains('01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII')) {
        _syafiiPresentations = books;
      }
      return books;
    } catch (e) {
      rethrow;
    }
  }

  /// Loads the canonical Syafi'i catalog from asset bundle (backwards compatible).
  Future<List<CanonicalBookPresentation>> loadSyafiiCatalog() async {
    if (_syafiiPresentations != null) {
      return _syafiiPresentations!;
    }
    return loadCatalogFromAsset('assets/data/01_KATALOG_FIKIH_SYAFII.json');
  }

  /// Get cached presentations or null if not yet loaded.
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? get cachedSyafiiBooks => _syafiiPresentations;

  /// Get parsed canonical import or null if not yet loaded.
  CanonicalImport? get rawSyafiiCatalog => _syafiiCatalog;

  /// Filter books by query string with diacritic-tolerant Arabic & Latin normalization.
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation> filterBooks(
    List<CanonicalBookPresentation> books,
    String query, {
    String? eraFilter,
    String? typeFilter,
    String? sectionFilter,
    String? centuryFilter,
  }) {
    final cleanQuery = query.trim();

    return books.where((book) {
      if (eraFilter != null && eraFilter.isNotEmpty && book.reviewedEraLabel != eraFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (typeFilter != null && typeFilter.isNotEmpty && book.reviewedTypeLabel != typeFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (sectionFilter != null && sectionFilter.isNotEmpty && book.sectionArabic != sectionFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (centuryFilter != null && centuryFilter.isNotEmpty) {
        final year = book.verifiedDeathYearHijri;
        if (centuryFilter == 'Salaf (≤ 300 H)') {
          if (year == null || year > 300) return false;
        } else if (centuryFilter == 'Mutaqaddimin (301-600 H)') {
          if (year == null || year <= 300 || year > 600) return false;
        } else if (centuryFilter == 'Muta\'akhkhirin (601-1100 H)') {
          if (year == null || year <= 600 || year > 1100) return false;
        } else if (centuryFilter == 'Mu\'ashir (> 1100 H)') {
          if (year != null && year <= 1100) return false;
        }
      }

      if (cleanQuery.isEmpty) return true;

      final matchTitle = ArabicUtils.matches(book.titleArabic, cleanQuery) ||
          (book.shortTitleArabic != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.shortTitleArabic!, cleanQuery)) ||
          (book.titleLatin != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.titleLatin!, cleanQuery));
      final matchAuthor = ArabicUtils.matches(book.authorArabic, cleanQuery) ||
          (book.authorLatin != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.authorLatin!, cleanQuery));
      final matchPublisher = book.publisher != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.publisher!, cleanQuery);
      final matchMuhaqqiq = book.muhaqqiq != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.muhaqqiq!, cleanQuery);
      final matchSection = book.sectionArabic != null && ArabicUtils.matches(book.sectionArabic!, cleanQuery);

      return matchTitle || matchAuthor || matchPublisher || matchMuhaqqiq || matchSection;
    }).toList();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io' show Platform;
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:device_info_plus/device_info_plus.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

class DeviceFingerprint {
  final String deviceId;
  final String brand;
  final String model;
  final bool isPhysicalDevice;

  const DeviceFingerprint({
    required this.deviceId,
    required this.brand,
    required this.model,
    required this.isPhysicalDevice,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'deviceId': deviceId,
        'brand': brand,
        'model': model,
        'isPhysicalDevice': isPhysicalDevice,
      };

  @override
  String toString() =>
      'DeviceFingerprint(deviceId: ${deviceId.substring(0, 8)}..., model: $model, physical: $isPhysicalDevice)';
}

class DeviceService {
  static final DeviceService _instance = DeviceService._internal();
  factory DeviceService() => _instance;
  DeviceService._internal();

  final DeviceInfoPlugin _deviceInfo = DeviceInfoPlugin();

  static const String _salt = 'OT_AI_HW_SALT_2026_980031db';

  /// Menghitung hash SHA-256 salted dari identitas hardware perangkat.
  /// Bersifat deterministik dan aman untuk privasi pengguna.
  static String computeHash({
    required String rawId,
    required String brand,
    required String model,
  }) {
    final cleanId = rawId.trim();
    final cleanBrand = brand.trim().toLowerCase();
    final cleanModel = model.trim().toLowerCase();
    final payload = '$_salt::$cleanId::$cleanBrand::$cleanModel';
    return sha256.convert(utf8.encode(payload)).toString();
  }

  /// Mengambil sidik jari perangkat saat ini (Device Fingerprint).
  Future<DeviceFingerprint> getDeviceFingerprint() async {
    try {
      if (kIsWeb) {
        final webInfo = await _deviceInfo.webBrowserInfo;
        final rawId = webInfo.userAgent ?? 'web_browser';
        final brand = webInfo.vendor ?? 'browser';
        final model = webInfo.browserName.name;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);
        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: true,
        );
      }

      if (Platform.isAndroid) {
        final androidInfo = await _deviceInfo.androidInfo;
        final rawId = androidInfo.id; // Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID
        final brand = androidInfo.brand;
        final model = androidInfo.model;
        final isPhysical = androidInfo.isPhysicalDevice;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);

        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: isPhysical,
        );
      }

      if (Platform.isIOS) {
        final iosInfo = await _deviceInfo.iosInfo;
        final rawId = iosInfo.identifierForVendor ?? 'ios_device';
        const brand = 'apple';
        final model = iosInfo.utsname.machine;
        final isPhysical = iosInfo.isPhysicalDevice;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);

        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: isPhysical,
        );
      }

      if (Platform.isMacOS) {
        final macInfo = await _deviceInfo.macOsInfo;
        final rawId = macInfo.systemGUID ?? 'macos_device';
        const brand = 'apple';
        final model = macInfo.model;
        final hash = computeHash(rawId: rawId, brand: brand, model: model);

        return DeviceFingerprint(
          deviceId: hash,
          brand: brand,
          model: model,
          isPhysicalDevice: true,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[DeviceService] Warning failed to inspect device info: $e');
    }

    // Fallback darurat (misalnya unit test harness lokal tanpa platform channel)
    const fallbackId = 'ot_fallback_dev_0000000000000000';
    final fallbackHash = computeHash(
      rawId: fallbackId,
      brand: 'generic',
      model: 'generic_device',
    );
    return DeviceFingerprint(
      deviceId: fallbackHash,
      brand: 'generic',
      model: 'generic_device',
      isPhysicalDevice: true,
    );
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';

/// DokuService — Layanan checkout DOKU yang aman & terpusat.
/// Seluruh kalkulasi signature HMAC dan interaksi ke API DOKU
/// dieksekusi secara eksklusif oleh Cloud Functions (server-side),
/// sehingga tidak ada Secret Key yang tersimpan di dalam client/APK.
class DokuService {
  final FirebaseFunctions _functions = FirebaseFunctions.instance;

  /// Buat sesi pembayaran checkout resmi melalui Cloud Function createCheckout
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createCheckoutSession({
    required String uid,
    required String agentId,
    required String plan,
    required String planTitle,
    required int amount,
    required String name,
    required String email,
    required String phone,
  }) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable(AppConstants.fnCreatePayment);
      final result = await callable.call({
        'uid': uid,
        'agentId': agentId,
        'plan': plan,
        'planTitle': planTitle,
        'amount': amount,
        'name': name,
        'email': email,
        'phone': phone,
      });

      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data as Map);
      return {
        'redirectUrl': data['paymentUrl'] ?? data['redirectUrl'],
        'paymentUrl': data['paymentUrl'] ?? data['redirectUrl'],
        'trxId': data['trxId'] ?? '',
        'invoiceNumber': data['invoiceNumber'] ?? '',
        'status': 'pending',
      };
    } catch (e) {
      throw Exception('Gagal membuat sesi pembayaran DOKU: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Periksa status pembayaran secara aktif langsung ke Cloud Functions
  /// yang memverifikasi transaksi langsung ke DOKU Orders API.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> checkPaymentStatus({
    required String invoiceNumber,
  }) async {
    try {
      final callable = _functions.httpsCallable(AppConstants.fnCheckPaymentStatus);
      final result = await callable.call({'invoiceNumber': invoiceNumber});
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(result.data as Map);
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        'success': false,
        'status': 'ERROR',
        'error': e.toString(),
      };
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

/// NativeAgentLauncher: Menangani pembukaan asisten langsung ke aplikasi resmi
/// Google Gemini Notebook (com.google.android.apps.labs.language.tailwind) secara instan (0.1 detik)
/// tanpa overhead browser atau webview jika aplikasi terinstal.
class NativeAgentLauncher {
  static const MethodChannel _channel = MethodChannel('com.openturath.ai/native_launcher');

  /// Cek apakah aplikasi resmi Google Gemini Notebook terpasang di perangkat
  static Future<bool> isNotebookAppInstalled() async {
    if (!Platform.isAndroid) return false;
    try {
      final bool? installed = await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('isNotebookAppInstalled');
      return installed == true;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Buka URL notebook langsung di aplikasi resmi native Gemini Notebook
  /// Mengembalikan `true` jika berhasil diluncurkan langsung ke aplikasi native.
  static Future<bool> launchNotebook(String url) async {
    final cleanUrl = url.replaceAll('/preview', '');

    // 1. Prioritaskan peluncuran Intent langsung ke com.google.android.apps.labs.language.tailwind
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      try {
        final bool? success = await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('openInNotebookApp', {
          'url': cleanUrl,
        });
        if (success == true) {
          return true;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 2. Coba peluncuran non-browser via url_launcher
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse(cleanUrl);
      final bool launched = await launchUrl(
        uri,
        mode: LaunchMode.externalNonBrowserApplication,
      );
      if (launched) return true;
    } catch (_) {}

    return false;
  }

  /// Membuka Share Sheet native Android untuk membagikan modul AI
  static Future<bool> shareText({required String text, String title = 'Bagikan Modul'}) async {
    if (!Platform.isAndroid) return false;
    try {
      final bool? success = await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('shareText', {
        'text': text,
        'title': title,
      });
      return success == true;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
class ResearchNote {
  final String id;
  final String agentId;

  final String excerpt;
  final String? bookTitle;
  final String? bookVolume;
  final String? bookPage;

  ResearchNote({
    required this.id,
    required this.agentId,
    required this.agentTitle,
    required this.title,
    required this.excerpt,
    this.bookTitle,
    this.bookVolume,
    this.bookPage,
    this.tags = const [],
    required this.createdAt,
  });

  String get citationFormatted {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('"$excerpt"');
    buffer.writeln();
    buffer.write('Sumber: OpenTurath AI ($agentTitle)');
    if (bookTitle != null && bookTitle!.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.write(', Kitab $bookTitle');
      if (bookVolume != null && bookVolume!.isNotEmpty) buffer.write(' Juz $bookVolume');
      if (bookPage != null && bookPage!.isNotEmpty) buffer.write(' Hal $bookPage');
    }
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'id': id,
        'agent_id': agentId,
        'agent_title': agentTitle,
        'title': title,
        'excerpt': excerpt,
        'book_title': bookTitle,
        'book_volume': bookVolume,
        'book_page': bookPage,
        'tags': tags,
        'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory ResearchNote.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => ResearchNote(
        id: map['id'] ?? '',
        agentId: map['agent_id'] ?? '',
        agentTitle: map['agent_title'] ?? '',
        title: map['title'] ?? '',
        excerpt: map['excerpt'] ?? '',
        bookTitle: map['book_title'],
        bookVolume: map['book_volume'],
        bookPage: map['book_page'],
        tags: List<String>.from(map['tags'] ?? []),
        createdAt: DateTime.tryParse(map['created_at'] ?? '') ?? DateTime.now(),
      );
}

/// Service Penyimpanan Catatan & Bookmark Riset Lokal (Offline-first)
class ResearchNotesService {
  final _store = ScopedJsonListStore<ResearchNote>(
    storage: PreferencesStringStore(), decode: ResearchNote.fromMap,
    encode: (note) => note.toMap(),
  );
  String _key(String? userId) {
    final uid = userId ?? FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    return uid == null || uid.isEmpty ? 'openturath_research_notes_v1' : 'openturath_${uid}_research_notes_v1';
  }
  Future<List<ResearchNote>> getNotes({String? agentId, String? userId}) async {
    final key = _key(userId);
    final notes = await _store.read(key);
    notes.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.compareTo(a.createdAt));
    return agentId == null || agentId.isEmpty ? notes : notes.where((n) => n.agentId == agentId).toList();
  }
  Future<void> saveNote(ResearchNote note, {String? userId}) {
    final key = _key(userId);
    return _store.update(key, (notes) {
      notes.removeWhere((n) => n.id == note.id);
      notes.insert(0, note);
      return notes;
    });
  }
  Future<void> deleteNote(String noteId, {String? userId}) {
    final key = _key(userId);
    return _store.update(key, (notes) => notes..removeWhere((n) => n.id == noteId));
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

abstract class StringStore {
  Future<String?> read(String key);
  Future<bool> write(String key, String value);
}

class PreferencesStringStore implements StringStore {
  @override
  Future<String?> read(String key) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final value = prefs.get(key);
    if (value is String) return value;
    if (value is List) {
      // Backward compatibility for legacy SharedPreferences stored as List<String>
      final items = <dynamic>[];
      for (final item in value) {
        if (item is String) {
          try {
            items.add(jsonDecode(item));
          } catch (_) {
            items.add(item);
          }
        } else {
          items.add(item);
        }
      }
      return jsonEncode(items);
    }
    return null;
  }

  @override
  Future<bool> write(String key, String value) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (prefs.containsKey(key) && prefs.get(key) is! String) {
      await prefs.remove(key);
    }
    return prefs.setString(key, value);
  }
}

class ScopedJsonListStore<T> {
  final StringStore storage;
  final T Function(Map<String, dynamic>) decode;
  final Map<String, dynamic> Function(T) encode;
  static final Map<String, Future<void>> _tails = {};

  ScopedJsonListStore({required this.storage, required this.decode, required this.encode});

  Future<R> _locked<R>(String key, Future<R> Function() action) async {
    final previous = _tails[key];
    final done = Completer<void>();
    _tails[key] = done.future;
    try {
      if (previous != null) await previous;
      return await action();
    } finally {
      done.complete();
      if (identical(_tails[key], done.future)) _tails.remove(key);
    }
  }

  Future<List<T>> _read(String key) async {
    final raw = await storage.read(key);
    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) return <T>[];
    try {
      final data = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (data is! List) throw const FormatException('Expected a list');
      return data.map((row) {
        if (row is! Map) throw const FormatException('Expected an object');
        return decode(Map<String, dynamic>.from(row));
      }).toList();
    } on Object {
      final digest = sha256.convert(utf8.encode(raw));
      final quarantine = '${key}_corrupt_$digest';
      if (await storage.read(quarantine) != raw && !await storage.write(quarantine, raw)) {
        throw StateError('Cannot preserve damaged saved data');
      }
      return <T>[];
    }
  }

  Future<List<T>> read(String key) => _locked(key, () => _read(key));

  Future<void> replace(String key, List<T> items) {
    final snapshot = List<T>.of(items);
    return _locked(key, () async {
      await _read(key); // Preserve corrupt old bytes before replacing them.
      await _write(key, snapshot);
    });
  }

  Future<void> update(String key, List<T> Function(List<T>) edit) => _locked(key, () async {
    final current = await _read(key);
    await _write(key, edit(current));
  });

  Future<void> _write(String key, List<T> items) async {
    final raw = jsonEncode(items.map(encode).toList());
    if (!await storage.write(key, raw)) throw StateError('Saved data could not be written');
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';

Stream<T?> sessionUserStream<T>({
  required Stream<String?> auth,
  required Future<T?> Function(String) cached,
  required Stream<T?> Function(String) watch,
}) {
  final listeners = <MultiStreamController<T?>>{};
  StreamSubscription<String?>? authSub;
  StreamSubscription<T?>? documentSub;
  var generation = 0;
  var hasValue = false;
  T? last;

  bool current(int token) => token == generation && listeners.isNotEmpty;
  void emit(int token, T? value) {
    if (!current(token)) return;
    hasValue = true;
    last = value;
    for (final listener in listeners.toList()) { listener.add(value); }
  }
  void error(int token, Object value, StackTrace stack) {
    if (!current(token)) return;
    for (final listener in listeners.toList()) { listener.addError(value, stack); }
  }
  Future<void> cancel(StreamSubscription<dynamic>? sub) async {
    try { await sub?.cancel(); } catch (_) { /* Generation already invalidates events. */ }
  }
  Future<void> switchUser(String? uid) async {
    final token = ++generation;
    final previous = documentSub;
    documentSub = null;
    emit(token, null); // Clear prior identity before asynchronous cache lookup.
    await cancel(previous);
    if (!current(token) || uid == null) return;
    try {
      final value = await cached(uid).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
      if (!current(token)) return;
      if (value != null) emit(token, value);
    } catch (_) { /* Continue with the authoritative snapshot stream. */ }
    if (!current(token)) return;
    try {
      documentSub = watch(uid).listen(
        (value) => emit(token, value),
        onError: (Object e, StackTrace stack) => error(token, e, stack),
      );
    } catch (e, stack) { error(token, e, stack); }
  }

  return Stream<T?>.multi((listener) {
    listeners.add(listener);
    if (hasValue) listener.add(last);
    if (listeners.length == 1) {
      authSub = auth.listen((uid) { unawaited(switchUser(uid)); },
        onError: (Object e, StackTrace stack) => error(generation, e, stack));
    }
    listener.onCancel = () async {
      listeners.remove(listener);
      if (listeners.isNotEmpty) return;
      generation++;
      hasValue = false;
      last = null;
      final oldAuth = authSub;
      final oldDocument = documentSub;
      authSub = null;
      documentSub = null;
      await Future.wait([cancel(oldAuth), cancel(oldDocument)]);
    };
  }, isBroadcast: true);
}
```

```dart
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:cloud_functions/cloud_functions.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';
import '../models/user_model.dart';
import 'device_service.dart';
import 'doku_service.dart';

class SubscriptionService {
  final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  final DokuService _dokuService = DokuService();

  /// Normalisasi kode voucher: hapus spasi, ubah huruf kapital, hapus tanda strip
  static String normalizeCode(String input) {
    return input.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\s-]'), '');
  }

  static String redeemErrorMessage(String code, [String? serverMessage]) {
    final c = code.toLowerCase().replaceAll('_', '-');
    if (serverMessage != null && serverMessage.isNotEmpty) {
      final lowerMsg = serverMessage.toLowerCase();
      if (lowerMsg.contains('perangkat') || lowerMsg.contains('ponsel')) {
        return serverMessage;
      }
    }
    if (c.contains('not-found')) return 'Kode voucher tidak ditemukan. Periksa kembali penulisan kode Anda.';
    if (c.contains('already-exists') || c.contains('already-used')) {
      return 'Kode ini sudah pernah ditukarkan sebelumnya.';
    }
    if (c.contains('deadline-exceeded') || c.contains('expired')) return 'Masa berlaku kode voucher ini telah berakhir.';
    if (c.contains('failed-precondition')) {
      if (serverMessage != null && serverMessage.contains('ponsel')) {
        return serverMessage;
      }
      return 'Kode voucher ini sudah tidak aktif.';
    }
    if (c.contains('resource-exhausted') || c.contains('quota')) return 'Kuota penukaran untuk kode voucher ini sudah habis.';
    if (c.contains('unauthenticated')) return 'Silakan masuk ke akun Anda lalu coba kembali.';
    if (c.contains('invalid-argument')) return 'Format penulisan kode voucher belum sesuai.';
    if (c.contains('permission-denied')) return 'Kode voucher ini tidak dapat digunakan untuk akun Anda.';
    if (c.contains('unavailable')) return 'Layanan belum dapat dihubungi. Periksa koneksi lalu coba lagi.';
    return 'Kode voucher belum dapat diaktifkan. Silakan periksa kembali kode Anda.';
  }

  // ── Klaim Kode Redeem Santri (Voucher Akses 7 Hari, dsb) ─────
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> redeemAccessCode(
    String code, {
    DeviceFingerprint? customFingerprint,
  }) async {
    try {
      final normalized = normalizeCode(code);
      final fingerprint = customFingerprint ?? await DeviceService().getDeviceFingerprint();
      final callable = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('redeemCode');
      final result = await callable.call({
        'code': normalized,
        'deviceId': fingerprint.deviceId,
        'deviceModel': fingerprint.model,
        'deviceBrand': fingerprint.brand,
        'isPhysicalDevice': fingerprint.isPhysicalDevice,
      });
      final data = result.data;
      if (data is Map) {
        return Map<String, dynamic>.from(data);
      }
      return {'success': true, 'message': 'Kode akses sudah aktif.'};
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      final serverMsg = e.message;
      if (serverMsg != null &&
          serverMsg.isNotEmpty &&
          (serverMsg.contains('perangkat') || serverMsg.contains('ponsel'))) {
        return {'success': false, 'message': serverMsg};
      }
      return {'success': false, 'message': redeemErrorMessage(e.code, serverMsg)};
    } catch (e) {
      return {'success': false, 'message': 'Koneksi bermasalah. Periksa internet Anda lalu coba lagi.'};
    }
  }

  // ── Buat Payment Request resmi ke DOKU Payment Gateway ───────
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createPayment({
    required String uid,
    required String agentId,
    required String plan,
    required String name,
    required String email,
    required String phone,
    String? planTitle,
    int? amount,
  }) async {
    final resolvedAmount = amount ?? _getPriceForPlan(plan);
    final resolvedTitle = planTitle ?? _getTitleForPlan(plan);

    // Eksekusi checkout DOKU melalui Cloud Functions
    return await _dokuService.createCheckoutSession(
      uid: uid,
      agentId: agentId,
      plan: plan,
      planTitle: resolvedTitle,
      amount: resolvedAmount,
      name: name,
      email: email,
      phone: phone,
    );
  }

  // ── Cek status transaksi secara aktif (inquiry ke DOKU API via Cloud Function) ──
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> verifyPaymentStatus({
    required String invoiceNumber,
    String? trxId,
  }) async {
    // 1. Panggil checkPaymentStatus Cloud Function yang inquiry langsung ke DOKU
    final res = await _dokuService.checkPaymentStatus(invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber);
    if (res['status'] == 'SUCCESS' || res['success'] == true) {
      return res;
    }

    // 2. Fallback cek Firestore transaction jika ada trxId
    if (trxId != null && trxId.isNotEmpty) {
      final doc = await _db.collection(AppConstants.colTransactions).doc(trxId).get();
      if (doc.exists && doc.data()?['status'] == 'success') {
        return {'success': true, 'status': 'SUCCESS'};
      }
    }

    return res;
  }

  // ── Legacy polling helper ────────────────────────────────────
  Future<String> checkPaymentStatus(String trxId) async {
    final doc =
        await _db.collection(AppConstants.colTransactions).doc(trxId).get();
    if (!doc.exists) return 'pending';
    return (doc.data()?['status'] ?? 'pending') as String;
  }

  // ── Stream status user secara real-time ───────────────────────
  Stream<UserModel?> watchUserSubscription(String uid) {
    return _db
        .collection(AppConstants.colUsers)
        .doc(uid)
        .snapshots()
        .map((doc) => doc.exists ? UserModel.fromFirestore(doc) : null);
  }

  int _getPriceForPlan(String plan) {
    switch (plan) {
      case AppConstants.planTholib1m:
        return AppConstants.priceTholib1m;
      case AppConstants.planTholib6m:
        return AppConstants.priceTholib6m;
      case AppConstants.planBahits1y:
        return AppConstants.priceBahits1y;
      case 'all_ai_1m':
        return AppConstants.priceAllAiPromo1m;
      default:
        return AppConstants.priceTholib1m;
    }
  }

  String _getTitleForPlan(String plan) {
    switch (plan) {
      case AppConstants.planTholib1m:
        return 'Modul AI (1 Bulan)';
      case AppConstants.planTholib6m:
        return 'Modul AI (6 Bulan)';
      case AppConstants.planBahits1y:
        return 'Modul AI (1 Tahun)';
      default:
        return 'Langganan Modul AI OpenTurath';
    }
  }
}
```
