```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/// TelemetryService: Sistem Pemantauan Crash & Error Senyap (Silent Telemetry)
/// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class TelemetryService {
  TelemetryService._({FirebaseFirestore? firestore, FirebaseAuth? auth})
      : _firestore = firestore,
        _auth = auth;

  static final TelemetryService instance = TelemetryService._();

  FirebaseFirestore? _firestore;
  FirebaseAuth? _auth;

  FirebaseFirestore get _db => _firestore ?? FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  FirebaseAuth get _firebaseAuth => _auth ?? FirebaseAuth.instance;

  /// Visible for testing to inject mock instances
  @visibleForTesting
  void setMockInstances({FirebaseFirestore? firestore, FirebaseAuth? auth}) {
    _firestore = firestore;
    _auth = auth;
  }

  /// Ring buffer untuk breadcrumbs (maksimal 20 peristiwa terakhir)
  static const int maxBreadcrumbs = 20;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _breadcrumbs = [];

  /// Deduplikasi error (mencegah log flooding untuk error yang berulang dalam 120 detik)
  static const Duration _dedupWindow = Duration(seconds: 120);
  final Map<String, DateTime> _reportedSignatures = {};

  bool _initialized = false;

  /// Inisialisasi global unhandled error handlers
  void init() {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;

    // 1. Flutter Framework Errors (Widget building, layout, etc.)
    final originalOnError = FlutterError.onError;
    FlutterError.onError = (FlutterErrorDetails details) {
      reportError(
        details.exception,
        details.stack,
        context: 'flutter_framework_error',
        severity: 'error',
        extra: {
          'library': details.library,
          'summary': details.summary.toString(),
        },
      );
      if (originalOnError != null) {
        originalOnError(details);
      } else {
        FlutterError.presentError(details);
      }
    };

    // 2. Platform Dispatcher Errors (Async errors, isolates, microtasks)
    PlatformDispatcher.instance.onError = (Object error, StackTrace stack) {
      reportError(
        error,
        stack,
        context: 'unhandled_async_error',
        severity: 'critical',
      );
      return false; // biarkan default handling berjalan
    };

    leaveBreadcrumb('Aplikasi dimulai (Telemetry aktif)', category: 'lifecycle');
  }

  /// Rekam jejak interaksi pengguna / sistem ke in-memory ring buffer
  void leaveBreadcrumb(String message, {String category = 'action'}) {
    try {
      final sanitized = sanitizeData(message);
      _breadcrumbs.add({
        'message': sanitized,
        'category': category,
        'timestamp': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
      });
      if (_breadcrumbs.length > maxBreadcrumbs) {
        _breadcrumbs.removeAt(0);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Masking data sensitif (password, authorization token, voucher, email)
  String sanitizeData(String input) {
    if (input.isEmpty) return input;
    var sanitized = input;

    // 1. Mask Bearer / Token
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'bearer\s+[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+', caseSensitive: false),
      'Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]',
    );

    // 2. Mask password / apikey / secret / auth
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAllMapped(
      RegExp(r'''(password|secret|apiKey|api_key|token|access_token|refreshToken)["':\s=]+[^,\s\n}]+''', caseSensitive: false),
      (match) => '${match.group(1)}: "[REDACTED]"',
    );

    // 3. Mask Google SID/HSID/SSID cookies
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAllMapped(
      RegExp(r'(SID|HSID|SSID|APISID|SAPISID)=[^;\s]+', caseSensitive: false),
      (match) => '${match.group(1)}=[REDACTED_COOKIE]',
    );

    // 4. Mask voucher codes bila ada
    sanitized = sanitized.replaceAllMapped(
      RegExp(r'''(voucher|code)["':\s=]+[a-zA-Z0-9\-_]{5,20}''', caseSensitive: false),
      (match) => '${match.group(1)}: "[REDACTED_CODE]"',
    );

    return sanitized;
  }

  /// Mask email pengguna untuk kepatuhan privasi (cth: a***@domain.com)
  String maskEmail(String email) {
    if (email.isEmpty || !email.contains('@')) return '';
    final parts = email.split('@');
    final name = parts[0];
    final domain = parts[1];
    if (name.length <= 2) {
      return '*@$domain';
    }
    return '${name[0]}***${name[name.length - 1]}@$domain';
  }

  /// Buat signature unik untuk deduplikasi error
  String _computeErrorSignature(String errorStr, String? context, String? stackTraceStr) {
    final firstThreeLines = (stackTraceStr ?? '')
        .split('\n')
        .where((l) => l.trim().isNotEmpty)
        .take(3)
        .join('|');
    final raw = '${errorStr.trim()}::$context::$firstThreeLines';
    return md5.convert(utf8.encode(raw)).toString();
  }

  /// Kirim error ke Firestore secara senyap (unawaited)
  Future<void> reportError(
    dynamic error,
    dynamic stackTrace, {
    String? context,
    String severity = 'error',
    Map<String, dynamic>? extra,
  }) async {
    try {
      final errorStr = sanitizeData(error?.toString() ?? 'Unknown Error');
      final stackStr = sanitizeData(stackTrace?.toString() ?? '');

      // Cek deduplikasi
      final signature = _computeErrorSignature(errorStr, context, stackStr);
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final lastReported = _reportedSignatures[signature];
      if (lastReported != null && now.difference(lastReported) < _dedupWindow) {
        return; // Lewati karena baru saja dilaporkan dalam kurun dedupWindow
      }
      _reportedSignatures[signature] = now;

      // Bersihkan signature lama yang sudah lewat window
      _reportedSignatures.removeWhere((_, time) => now.difference(time) > _dedupWindow);

      final user = _firebaseAuth.currentUser;
      final maskedUserEmail = user?.email != null ? maskEmail(user!.email!) : '';

      final sanitizedExtra = <String, dynamic>{};
      if (extra != null) {
        for (final entry in extra.entries) {
          sanitizedExtra[entry.key] = sanitizeData(entry.value?.toString() ?? '');
        }
      }

      final payload = {
        'error': errorStr.length > 2000 ? errorStr.substring(0, 2000) : errorStr,
        'context': context ?? 'general',
        'severity': severity,
        'stackTrace': stackStr.length > 5000 ? stackStr.substring(0, 5000) : stackStr,
        'breadcrumbs': List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(_breadcrumbs),
        'extra': sanitizedExtra,
        'userId': user?.uid ?? 'unauthenticated',
        'userEmail': maskedUserEmail,
        'platform': kIsWeb ? 'web' : Platform.operatingSystem,
        'deviceTimestamp': now.toIso8601String(),
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };

      // Tulis secara senyap ke Firestore koleksi client_error_logs
      unawaited(
        _db.collection('client_error_logs').add(payload).catchError((_) {
          return null as dynamic;
        }),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      // Menjamin TelemetryService tidak pernah melempar exception ke aplikasi
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:open_filex/open_filex.dart';
import 'package:package_info_plus/package_info_plus.dart';
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

enum UpdateStatus {
  idle,
  checking,
  downloading,
  readyToInstall,
  error,
}

class UpdateInfo {
  final String latestVersion;
  final int latestVersionCode;
  final String apkUrl;
  final String releaseNotes;
  final String? sha256Hash;
  final bool isDownloaded;
  final String? localFilePath;
  final double downloadProgress; // 0.0 to 1.0

  const UpdateInfo({
    required this.latestVersion,
    required this.latestVersionCode,
    required this.apkUrl,
    required this.releaseNotes,
    this.sha256Hash,
    this.isDownloaded = false,
    this.localFilePath,
    this.downloadProgress = 0.0,
  });

  UpdateInfo copyWith({
    String? latestVersion,
    int? latestVersionCode,
    String? apkUrl,
    String? releaseNotes,
    String? sha256Hash,
    bool? isDownloaded,
    String? localFilePath,
    double? downloadProgress,
  }) {
    return UpdateInfo(
      latestVersion: latestVersion ?? this.latestVersion,
      latestVersionCode: latestVersionCode ?? this.latestVersionCode,
      apkUrl: apkUrl ?? this.apkUrl,
      releaseNotes: releaseNotes ?? this.releaseNotes,
      sha256Hash: sha256Hash ?? this.sha256Hash,
      isDownloaded: isDownloaded ?? this.isDownloaded,
      localFilePath: localFilePath ?? this.localFilePath,
      downloadProgress: downloadProgress ?? this.downloadProgress,
    );
  }
}

/// UpdateService: Background Auto-Downloader & Instant One-Click Installer
/// - Mengunduh file APK di latar belakang secara diam-diam (silent download) di Android
/// - Di macOS/Windows: Membuka laman unduh rilis desktop via browser eksternal
/// - Dilengkapi mutex unduhan, sanitasi sink I/O, dan verifikasi integritas SHA-256
class UpdateService extends ChangeNotifier {
  static final UpdateService _instance = UpdateService._internal();
  factory UpdateService() => _instance;
  UpdateService._internal();

  UpdateStatus _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
  UpdateStatus get status => _status;

  UpdateInfo? _updateInfo;
  UpdateInfo? get updateInfo => _updateInfo;

  bool get isUpdateReady {
    if (_status != UpdateStatus.readyToInstall || _updateInfo == null) return false;
    if (!kIsWeb && !Platform.isAndroid) {
      // Desktop: siap membuka URL unduhan desktop
      return true;
    }
    return _updateInfo!.isDownloaded && _updateInfo!.localFilePath != null;
  }

  bool _isChecking = false;
  bool _isDownloading = false;

  /// Hitung SHA-256 secara streaming tanpa memuat seluruh file 60MB ke memori RAM (F20)
  static Future<String> _computeFileSha256(File file) async {
    final digest = await sha256.bind(file.openRead()).first;
    return digest.toString();
  }

  /// Memulai pengecekan versi dan unduhan otomatis di background
  Future<void> checkForUpdatesSilently() async {
    if (_isChecking || _isDownloading) return;
    _isChecking = true;

    try {
      _status = UpdateStatus.checking;
      notifyListeners();

      final packageInfo = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();
      final currentCode = int.tryParse(packageInfo.buildNumber) ?? 0;

      // Ambil konfigurasi versi dari Firestore (collection: app_config, doc: version)
      final doc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('app_config')
          .doc('version')
          .get();

      if (!doc.exists) {
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        _isChecking = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      final data = doc.data()!;
      final latestCode = (data['latest_version_code'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
      final latestVersion = (data['latest_version'] as String?) ?? packageInfo.version;
      final apkUrl = (data['apk_url'] as String?) ?? '';
      final releaseNotes = (data['release_notes'] as String?) ?? 'Pembaruan aplikasi OpenTurath AI';
      final sha256Hash = (data['sha256'] as String?)?.trim();

      // Jika versi di server lebih baru dari versi yang sedang terpasang
      if (latestCode > currentCode && apkUrl.isNotEmpty) {
        _updateInfo = UpdateInfo(
          latestVersion: latestVersion,
          latestVersionCode: latestCode,
          apkUrl: apkUrl,
          releaseNotes: releaseNotes,
          sha256Hash: sha256Hash,
        );

        if (!kIsWeb && !Platform.isAndroid) {
          // macOS / Windows Desktop: tampilkan banner siap update (buka URL)
          _updateInfo = _updateInfo!.copyWith(
            isDownloaded: true,
            downloadProgress: 1.0,
          );
          _status = UpdateStatus.readyToInstall;
          notifyListeners();
          return;
        }

        // Android: Periksa apakah APK versi tersebut SUDAH pernah terunduh di cache (F44)
        final localFile = await _getLocalApkFile(latestCode);
        bool isCachedValid = false;
        if (await localFile.exists() && (await localFile.length()) > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
          if (sha256Hash != null && sha256Hash.isNotEmpty) {
            try {
              final cachedSha = await _computeFileSha256(localFile);
              if (cachedSha.toLowerCase() == sha256Hash.toLowerCase()) {
                isCachedValid = true;
              } else {
                debugPrint('[UpdateService] Cached APK hash mismatch: $cachedSha vs $sha256Hash');
                await localFile.delete();
              }
            } catch (e) {
              debugPrint('[UpdateService] Error checking cached hash: $e');
              try {
                await localFile.delete();
              } catch (_) {}
            }
          } else {
            isCachedValid = true;
          }
        }

        if (isCachedValid) {
          _updateInfo = _updateInfo!.copyWith(
            isDownloaded: true,
            localFilePath: localFile.path,
            downloadProgress: 1.0,
          );
          _status = UpdateStatus.readyToInstall;
          notifyListeners();
        } else {
          // Belum terunduh atau cache tidak valid: Jalankan silent background download otomatis
          _startSilentDownload(apkUrl, localFile, sha256Hash);
        }
      } else {
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[UpdateService] Error checking updates: $e');
      _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
      notifyListeners();
    } finally {
      _isChecking = false;
    }
  }

  /// Unduh APK di latar belakang tanpa mengganggu user dengan mutex dan try-finally sink
  Future<void> _startSilentDownload(String url, File targetFile, String? expectedSha256) async {
    if (_isDownloading) return;
    _isDownloading = true;

    final client = HttpClient();
    try {
      _status = UpdateStatus.downloading;
      notifyListeners();

      // Bersihkan file update lama sebelum mulai unduh baru
      await _cleanOldUpdates(targetFile.path);

      final request = await client.getUrl(Uri.parse(url));
      final response = await request.close();

      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      final contentLength = response.contentLength;
      final tempFile = File('${targetFile.path}.tmp');
      if (await tempFile.exists()) {
        await tempFile.delete();
      }

      final sink = tempFile.openWrite();
      int receivedBytes = 0;

      try {
        await for (final chunk in response) {
          sink.add(chunk);
          receivedBytes += chunk.length;
          if (contentLength > 0) {
            final progress = receivedBytes / contentLength;
            _updateInfo = _updateInfo?.copyWith(downloadProgress: progress);
          }
        }
        await sink.flush();
      } finally {
        await sink.close();
      }

      // Validasi integritas ukuran file
      final tempLength = await tempFile.length();
      if (tempLength < 5 * 1024 * 1024 || (contentLength > 0 && tempLength < contentLength)) {
        debugPrint('[UpdateService] Unduhan tidak lengkap ($tempLength bytes)');
        if (await tempFile.exists()) await tempFile.delete();
        _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        return;
      }

      // Validasi SHA-256 secara streaming jika disediakan oleh Firestore app_config/version (F20)
      if (expectedSha256 != null && expectedSha256.isNotEmpty) {
        final calculatedSha256 = await _computeFileSha256(tempFile);
        if (calculatedSha256.toLowerCase() != expectedSha256.toLowerCase()) {
          debugPrint('[UpdateService] SHA256 checksum mismatch: $calculatedSha256 vs $expectedSha256');
          if (await tempFile.exists()) await tempFile.delete();
          _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
          notifyListeners();
          return;
        }
      }

      // Rename dari temp ke final APK
      if (await targetFile.exists()) {
        await targetFile.delete();
      }
      await tempFile.rename(targetFile.path);

      _updateInfo = _updateInfo?.copyWith(
        isDownloaded: true,
        localFilePath: targetFile.path,
        downloadProgress: 1.0,
      );
      _status = UpdateStatus.readyToInstall;
      notifyListeners();
      debugPrint('[UpdateService] Background download complete: ${targetFile.path}');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[UpdateService] Background download error: $e');
      _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
      notifyListeners();
    } finally {
      _isDownloading = false;
      client.close();
    }
  }

  /// Bersihkan file APK atau file sementara lama di direktori update
  Future<void> _cleanOldUpdates(String currentPath) async {
    try {
      final dir = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
      final updateDir = Directory('${dir.path}/updates');
      if (await updateDir.exists()) {
        final list = updateDir.listSync();
        for (final entity in list) {
          if (entity.path != currentPath && (entity.path.endsWith('.apk') || entity.path.endsWith('.tmp'))) {
            try {
              entity.deleteSync();
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Lokasi file APK di penyimpanan privat aplikasi
  Future<File> _getLocalApkFile(int versionCode) async {
    final dir = await getApplicationSupportDirectory();
    final updateDir = Directory('${dir.path}/updates');
    if (!await updateDir.exists()) {
      await updateDir.create(recursive: true);
    }
    return File('${updateDir.path}/OpenTurath_v$versionCode.apk');
  }

  /// Tombol "Pasang Sekarang" dipanggil:
  /// - Android: Langsung buka Package Installer sistem
  /// - Desktop (macOS/Windows): Buka tautan pembaruan langsung di browser
  Future<void> installNow() async {
    if (!isUpdateReady || _updateInfo == null) return;

    if (!kIsWeb && !Platform.isAndroid) {
      final downloadUrl = _updateInfo!.apkUrl;
      final uri = Uri.tryParse(downloadUrl);
      if (uri != null) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      }
      return;
    }

    final filePath = _updateInfo!.localFilePath;
    if (filePath == null) return;

    final file = File(filePath);
    if (!await file.exists()) {
      _status = UpdateStatus.idle;
      notifyListeners();
      return;
    }

    try {
      final result = await OpenFilex.open(
        filePath,
        type: 'application/vnd.android.package-archive',
      );
      debugPrint('[UpdateService] OpenFilex result: ${result.type} - ${result.message}');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[UpdateService] Install error: $e');
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
/// AgentMultiTabRoom: Persistent, multi-tab AI Study Room inspired by Google Chrome tabs.
/// Keeps up to 7 AI specialists running concurrently in memory without reloading.
class AgentMultiTabRoom extends StatefulWidget {
  const AgentMultiTabRoom({super.key});

  @override
  State<AgentMultiTabRoom> createState() => _AgentMultiTabRoomState();
}

class _AgentMultiTabRoomState extends State<AgentMultiTabRoom> {
  final AgentSessionManager _sessionManager = AgentSessionManager.instance;
  final BookmarkService _bookmarkService = BookmarkService();
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();
  bool _isSavingAnswer = false;

  Future<void> _saveActiveTabAnswer(AgentSessionTab session) async {
    if (_isSavingAnswer) return;
    final controller = session.webController;
    if (controller == null) return;
    setState(() => _isSavingAnswer = true);
    try {
      final result = await controller.evaluateJavascript(
        source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.latest() : ""',
      );
      final text = result is String ? result.trim() : '';
      if (text.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) AppSnackBar.warning(context, AppCopy.noAnswerToSave);
        return;
      }
      final ownerUid = _authService.currentUser?.uid;
      final bookmark = copiedAnswerBookmark(text, session.agent);
      await _bookmarkService.addBookmark(bookmark, userId: ownerUid);
      if (mounted) {
        OTMotion.success();
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.savedSuccess);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.saveFailed);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSavingAnswer = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _copyActiveTabAnswer(AgentSessionTab session) async {
    final controller = session.webController;
    if (controller == null) return;
    try {
      final result = await controller.evaluateJavascript(
        source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.latest() : ""',
      );
      final text = result is String ? result.trim() : '';
      if (text.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) AppSnackBar.warning(context, AppCopy.noAnswerToCopy);
        return;
      }
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
      if (mounted) {
        OTMotion.light();
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.answerCopied);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.copyFailed);
    }
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _sessionManager.addListener(_onSessionsChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _sessionManager.removeListener(_onSessionsChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSessionsChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

                return InkWell(

                  child: Container(

                        width: 1.0,

                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Icon(
                          Icons.chat_bubble_outline_rounded,
                          size: 13,
                          color: isActive ? textPrimary : textSecondary,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text(
                          session.agent.title.replaceFirst('AI ', ''),
                          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
                            color: isActive ? textPrimary : textSecondary,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        InkWell(
                          onTap: () => _sessionManager.closeTab(index),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(2),
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.close_rounded,
                              size: 14,
                              color: textSecondary,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: IndexedStack(
        index: _sessionManager.activeIndex,
        children: [
          for (int i = 0; i < sessions.length; i++)
            _SingleAgentTabWebView(
              key: ValueKey('agent_tab_${sessions[i].agent.id}'),
              session: sessions[i],
              isActive: i == _sessionManager.activeIndex,
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Single AI specialist WebView within the multi-tab IndexedStack.
/// Preserves full state, DOM, and JavaScript execution in memory.
class _SingleAgentTabWebView extends StatefulWidget {
  final AgentSessionTab session;
  final bool isActive;

  const _SingleAgentTabWebView({
    super.key,
    required this.session,
    required this.isActive,
  });

  @override
  State<_SingleAgentTabWebView> createState() => _SingleAgentTabWebViewState();
}

class _SingleAgentTabWebViewState extends State<_SingleAgentTabWebView> {
  final AgentService _agentService = AgentService();
  final BookmarkService _bookmarkService = BookmarkService();
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();

  static const String _turatsMasterScript = r"""
    (function() {
      if (window.top !== window || !['notebooklm.google.com', 'notebook.google.com'].includes(location.hostname)) return;

      var styleId = 'ot-hide-controls';
      var existingStyle = document.getElementById(styleId);
      if (!existingStyle) {
        var style = document.createElement('style');
        style.id = styleId;
        style.type = 'text/css';
        style.textContent = `
          top-bar, .top-bar, header, .header, .app-header, app-header,
          mat-toolbar, [role="banner"], .header-container, .header-row,
          .mobile-header, div[class*="mobile-header" i],
          labs-tailwind-logo, a.logo-link, .logo-container,
          a[aria-label*="Homepage" i], a[aria-label*="NotebookLM" i], a[aria-label*="Gemini" i],
          .title-input, input.title-input, .title-container, .notebook-title,
          .notebook-header, app-notebook-header, .title-card, mat-card.title-card,
          div[class*="title-card" i], div[class*="notebook-header" i],
          .project-header, div.source-badge-container,
          app-chat-guide, .chat-guide, div[class*="landing" i], div[class*="banner" i],
          .pro-badge,
          #gb, #gbwa, .gb_C, .gb_9a, .gb_8, .gb_U, div[id*="gb"],
          button[aria-label*="Settings" i], button[aria-label*="Setelan" i],
          button.mat-tonal-button, a[aria-label*="Google" i],
          .chat-disclaimer, .disclaimer, .footer-disclaimer, .chat-footer-disclaimer,
          [class*="disclaimer" i], [id*="disclaimer" i], footer[class*="disclaimer" i],
          div[class*="disclaimer" i], p[class*="disclaimer" i], span[class*="disclaimer" i],
          app-disclaimer, .disclaimer-container, .disclaimer-text, .bottom-disclaimer,
          .chat-input-subtext, .input-subtext, .query-disclaimer, .model-disclaimer,
          [aria-label*="disclaimer" i], footer, .chat-footer, .conversation-footer,
          div.chat-input-container + div,
          div[class*="input-container" i] + div,
          div[class*="query-container" i] + div,
          [data-ot-hidden] {
            display: none !important;
            visibility: hidden !important;
            height: 0px !important;
            max-height: 0px !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            margin: 0px !important;
            padding: 0px !important;
            font-size: 0px !important;
            line-height: 0px !important;
            opacity: 0 !important;
            pointer-events: none !important;
            border: none !important;
          }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none !important; width: 0px !important; }
          html, body, * { scrollbar-width: none !important; }
          .chat-panel-content, .chat-view, .conversation-container, .message-list, main {
            padding-top: 14px !important;
            padding-bottom: 24px !important;
            margin-top: 0px !important;
          }
        `;
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(style);
      }

      window.applyTurathFontScale = function(value) {
        var scale = Number(value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(scale)) return;
        scale = Math.max(0.85, Math.min(2, scale));
        var fontStyle = document.getElementById('ot-font-scale-style');
        if (!fontStyle) {
          fontStyle = document.createElement('style');
          fontStyle.id = 'ot-font-scale-style';
          (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(fontStyle);
        }
        fontStyle.textContent = `
          .chat-panel-content, .chat-view, .conversation-container, .message-list, [role="article"] {
            font-size: ${Math.round(scale * 15)}px !important;
            line-height: 1.65 !important;
          }
          .chat-panel-content p, .chat-view p, [role="article"] p,
          .chat-panel-content span, .chat-view span, [role="article"] span,
          .chat-panel-content li, .chat-view li, [role="article"] li {
            font-size: inherit !important;
            line-height: inherit !important;
          }
          [lang="ar"], .arabic, [dir="rtl"] {
            font-family: 'Tajawal', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif !important;
            font-size: ${Math.round(scale * 19)}px !important;
            line-height: 1.8 !important;
          }
        `;
      };
    })();
  """;

  static final _cloakScript = UserScript(
    source: _turatsMasterScript + notebookUiScript,
    injectionTime: UserScriptInjectionTime.AT_DOCUMENT_START,
    forMainFrameOnly: true,
  );

  Timer? _readinessTimer;
  DateTime? _loadingStarted;
  int _readySamples = 0;
  bool _checkingReady = false;
  bool? _lastIsDark;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.session.resolvedUrl == null) {
      _fetchUrl();
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _readinessTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final currentIsDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    if (_lastIsDark != null && _lastIsDark != currentIsDark) {
      widget.session.webController?.setSettings(
        settings: InAppWebViewSettings(
          forceDark: currentIsDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
          forceDarkStrategy: ForceDarkStrategy.PREFER_WEB_THEME_OVER_USER_AGENT_DARKENING,
          algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: true,
        ),
      );
      _applyThemeCss(currentIsDark);
    }
    _lastIsDark = currentIsDark;
  }

  Future<void> _applyThemeCss(bool isDark) async {
    final controller = widget.session.webController;
    if (controller == null) return;
    try {
      await controller.evaluateJavascript(
        source: 'if (window.otNotebook && typeof window.otNotebook.setTheme === "function") { window.otNotebook.setTheme($isDark); } else if (typeof applyOtTheme === "function") { applyOtTheme($isDark); }',
      );
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _startReadinessCheck() {
    _readinessTimer?.cancel();
    _loadingStarted = DateTime.now();
    _readySamples = 0;
    _readinessTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), (_) => _checkReady());
  }

  Future<void> _checkReady() async {
    if (_checkingReady || widget.session.webController == null || !mounted) return;
    _checkingReady = true;
    try {
      final controller = widget.session.webController!;
      final url = await controller.getUrl();
      final isLogin = url?.host == 'accounts.google.com' ||
          url?.host == 'accounts.youtube.com' ||
          url?.host == 'consent.google.com';
      final result = await controller.evaluateJavascript(
          source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.ready() : false');
      _readySamples = result == true ? _readySamples + 1 : 0;
      if (!mounted) return;
      final elapsedMs = _loadingStarted != null
          ? DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inMilliseconds
          : 0;
      if (isLogin || (_readySamples >= 7 && elapsedMs >= 6500)) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        if (mounted && widget.session.isWebLoading) {
          setState(() => widget.session.isWebLoading = false);
        }
      } else if (DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inSeconds >= 45) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            widget.session.isWebLoading = false;
            widget.session.errorMessage =
                'AI belum siap merespons. Periksa koneksi lalu coba muat kembali.';
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {
    } finally {
      _checkingReady = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _fetchUrl() async {
    final session = widget.session;
    setState(() {
      session.isUrlLoading = true;
      session.errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final url = await _agentService.getAgentUrl(session.agent.id);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (url != null && url.isNotEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          session.resolvedUrl = url;
          session.isUrlLoading = false;
        });
      } else {
        setState(() {
          session.isUrlLoading = false;
          session.errorMessage = 'Tautan asisten tidak valid.';
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      final msg = e.toString().toLowerCase();
      final isPaywall = msg.contains('permission-denied') || msg.contains('berlangganan');
      setState(() {
        session.isUrlLoading = false;
        session.isPaywallRequired = isPaywall;
        session.errorMessage = isPaywall
            ? 'Akses asisten ini memerlukan langganan aktif.'
            : 'Asisten belum bisa dihubungkan. Coba lagi.';
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final session = widget.session;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);

    if (session.isUrlLoading) {
      return AppLoader.fullscreen(
        title: session.agent.title,
        subtitle: AppCopy.loadingReferences,
        onCancel: () => AgentSessionManager.instance.closeRoom(),
      );
    }

    if (session.errorMessage != null) {
      return Container(
        color: canvas,
        child: AppErrorState(
          title: session.isPaywallRequired ? 'Akses Terbatas' : 'Asisten Belum Bisa Dibuka',
          message: session.errorMessage!,
          icon: session.isPaywallRequired ? Icons.workspace_premium_rounded : Icons.info_outline_rounded,
          onRetry: _fetchUrl,
          onBack: () => AgentSessionManager.instance.closeRoom(),
          backLabel: 'Kembali ke Beranda',
        ),
      );
    }

    final initialUri = WebUri(session.resolvedUrl!);

    return Stack(
      children: [
        InAppWebView(
          initialUrlRequest: URLRequest(url: initialUri),
          initialUserScripts: UnmodifiableListView([_cloakScript]),
          initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
            javaScriptEnabled: true,
            domStorageEnabled: true,
            databaseEnabled: true,
            useWideViewPort: true,
            loadWithOverviewMode: true,
            cacheEnabled: true,
            clearCache: false,
            transparentBackground: false,
            allowsInlineMediaPlayback: true,
            supportZoom: false,
            displayZoomControls: false,
            mixedContentMode: MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
            thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
            hardwareAcceleration: true,
            verticalScrollBarEnabled: false,
            horizontalScrollBarEnabled: false,
            forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
            forceDarkStrategy: ForceDarkStrategy.PREFER_WEB_THEME_OVER_USER_AGENT_DARKENING,
            algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: true,
            userAgent: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14; Mobile) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36',
          ),
          onWebViewCreated: (controller) {
            session.webController = controller;
            final ownerUid = _authService.currentUser?.uid;
            controller.addJavaScriptHandler(
              handlerName: 'otCopiedAnswer',
              callback: (args) async {
                final url = await controller.getUrl();
                if (ownerUid == null ||
                    url?.scheme != 'https' ||
                    !['notebooklm.google.com', 'notebook.google.com'].contains(url?.host) ||
                    args.isEmpty ||
                    args.first is! String) {
                  return false;
                }
                try {
                  final text = (args.first as String).trim();
                  if (text.isNotEmpty && text.length <= 200000) {
                    await _bookmarkService.addBookmark(
                      copiedAnswerBookmark(text, session.agent),
                      userId: ownerUid,
                    );
                    if (context.mounted) {
                      AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.answerCopied);
                    }
                    return true;
                  }
                } catch (_) {
                  if (context.mounted) {
                    AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.saveFailed);
                  }
                }
                return false;
              },
            );
            _startReadinessCheck();
          },
          onLoadStart: (controller, uri) {
            if (mounted && !session.isWebLoading) {
              setState(() => session.isWebLoading = true);
            }
            _startReadinessCheck();
          },
          onLoadStop: (controller, uri) async {
            await controller.evaluateJavascript(source: _turatsMasterScript + notebookUiScript);
            await _applyThemeCss(isDark);
            await controller.evaluateJavascript(
              source: 'if (typeof applyTurathFontScale === "function") { applyTurathFontScale(${session.fontScale}); }',
            );
            await _checkReady();
          },
          onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) async {
            if (progress >= 35) {
              await controller.evaluateJavascript(source: _turatsMasterScript + notebookUiScript);
              await _applyThemeCss(isDark);
            }
          },
          shouldOverrideUrlLoading: (controller, action) async {
            final uri = action.request.url;
            if (uri == null) return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
            if (NotebookNavigation.allowed(uri.uriValue)) {
              return NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW;
            }
            return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
          },
        ),

        // Fullscreen pulsing loader until NotebookLM UI is 100% prepared & ready
        if (session.isWebLoading)
          Positioned.fill(
            child: AppLoader.fullscreen(
              title: session.agent.title,
              subtitle: AppCopy.loadingReferences,
              onCancel: () => AgentSessionManager.instance.closeRoom(),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
  final String retryLabel;

  const AppErrorState({
    super.key,
    this.title = 'Koneksi terputus',
    this.message = 'Tidak dapat memuat data saat ini. Periksa koneksi internet lalu coba lagi.',

    this.onRetry,
    this.retryLabel = 'Coba lagi',
    this.onBack,
    this.backLabel = 'Kembali',
  });

  const AppErrorState.network({
    super.key,
    this.title = 'Koneksi terputus',
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';

/// AppLoader: Komponen visual baku tiga titik berdenyut (Three-Dots Pulse Loader).
/// Menyatukan 4 implementasi loader berbeda menjadi satu komponen berstandar Apple HIG.
class AppLoader extends StatefulWidget {
  final double dotSize;
  final double spacing;
  final Color? color;
  final String? title;
  final String? subtitle;
  final VoidCallback? onCancel;
  final String cancelLabel;
  final bool isFullscreen;

  const AppLoader({
    super.key,
    this.dotSize = 9.0,
    this.spacing = 5.0,
    this.color,
    this.title,
    this.subtitle,
    this.onCancel,
    this.cancelLabel = 'Batal',
    this.isFullscreen = false,
  });

  const AppLoader.fullscreen({
    super.key,
    this.dotSize = 10.0,
    this.spacing = 5.0,
    this.color,
    this.title,
    this.subtitle,
    this.onCancel,
    this.cancelLabel = 'Batal',
  }) : isFullscreen = true;

  @override
  State<AppLoader> createState() => _AppLoaderState();
}

class _AppLoaderState extends State<AppLoader> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1200),
    )..repeat();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final defaultAccent = isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight;
    final dotColor = widget.color ?? defaultAccent;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
    final textSecondary = isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;
    final canvas = isDark ? AppTheme.canvasDark : AppTheme.canvasLight;

    Widget content = Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
      children: [
        AnimatedBuilder(
          animation: _controller,
          builder: (context, child) {
            return Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: List.generate(3, (index) {
                final delay = index * 0.2;
                final t = (_controller.value - delay) % 1.0;
                final curveVal = Curves.easeInOutSine.transform(t < 0 ? t + 1.0 : t);
                final scale = 0.75 + (0.45 * (1.0 - (curveVal - 0.5).abs() * 2));
                final opacity = 0.3 + (0.7 * (1.0 - (curveVal - 0.5).abs() * 2));

                return Container(
                  margin: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: widget.spacing),
                  child: Transform.scale(
                    scale: scale,
                    child: Opacity(
                      opacity: opacity.clamp(0.25, 1.0),
                      child: Container(
                        width: widget.dotSize,
                        height: widget.dotSize,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          color: dotColor,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }),
            );
          },
        ),
        if (widget.title != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          Text(
            widget.title!,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: 16,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: textPrimary,
            ),
          ),
        ],
        if (widget.subtitle != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            widget.subtitle!,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: 12,
              color: textSecondary,
            ),
          ),
        ],
        if (widget.onCancel != null) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 24),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: widget.onCancel,
            style: TextButton.styleFrom(
              minimumSize: const Size(80, 44),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusPill),
              ),
            ),
            child: Text(
              widget.cancelLabel,
              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                color: textSecondary,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );

    if (widget.isFullscreen) {
      return Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        height: double.infinity,
        color: canvas,
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Center(child: content),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Center(child: content);
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

/// Wrapper interaktif bergaya Apple iOS dengan animasi kompresi mikro
/// (press-down scale), pantulan pegas halus, dan getaran haptic feedback taktil.
class AppleInteractiveWrapper extends StatefulWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLongPress;
  final double pressedScale;
  final Duration duration;
  final bool enableHaptic;
  final HapticFeedbackType hapticType;
  final BorderRadius? borderRadius;
  final String? semanticLabel;

  const AppleInteractiveWrapper({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.onLongPress,
    this.pressedScale = 0.975,
    this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 110),
    this.enableHaptic = true,
    this.hapticType = HapticFeedbackType.light,
    this.borderRadius,
    this.semanticLabel,
  });

  @override
  State<AppleInteractiveWrapper> createState() => _AppleInteractiveWrapperState();
}

enum HapticFeedbackType {
  light,
  medium,
  selection,
  none,
}

class _AppleInteractiveWrapperState extends State<AppleInteractiveWrapper>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late AnimationController _controller;
  late Animation<double> _scaleAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: widget.duration,
      reverseDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 140),
    );
    _scaleAnimation = Tween<double>(
      begin: 1.0,
      end: widget.pressedScale,
    ).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(
        parent: _controller,
        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        reverseCurve: Curves.easeOutBack,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _triggerHaptic() {
    if (!widget.enableHaptic) return;
    switch (widget.hapticType) {
      case HapticFeedbackType.light:
        HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
        break;
      case HapticFeedbackType.medium:
        HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
        break;
      case HapticFeedbackType.selection:
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        break;
      case HapticFeedbackType.none:
        break;
    }
  }

  void _handleTapDown(TapDownDetails details) {
    if (widget.onTap != null || widget.onLongPress != null) {
      _controller.forward();
    }
  }

  void _handleTapUp(TapUpDetails details) {
    if (widget.onTap != null || widget.onLongPress != null) {
      _controller.reverse();
    }
  }

  void _handleTapCancel() {
    if (widget.onTap != null || widget.onLongPress != null) {
      _controller.reverse();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final hasAction = widget.onTap != null || widget.onLongPress != null;
    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.maybeOf(context)?.disableAnimations ?? false;

    Widget result = reduceMotion
        ? widget.child
        : AnimatedBuilder(
            animation: _scaleAnimation,
            builder: (context, child) {
              return Transform.scale(
                scale: _scaleAnimation.value,
                child: child,
              );
            },
            child: widget.child,
          );

    if (hasAction) {
      result = Semantics(
        button: true,
        enabled: true,
        label: widget.semanticLabel,
        child: GestureDetector(
          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
          onTapDown: reduceMotion ? null : _handleTapDown,
          onTapUp: reduceMotion ? null : _handleTapUp,
          onTapCancel: reduceMotion ? null : _handleTapCancel,
          onTap: () {
            _triggerHaptic();
            widget.onTap?.call();
          },
          onLongPress: widget.onLongPress != null
              ? () {
                  HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                  widget.onLongPress?.call();
                }
              : null,
          child: result,
        ),
      );
    }

    return result;
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_inappwebview/flutter_inappwebview.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';

import '../core/constants.dart';
import '../core/checkout_completion.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../services/subscription_service.dart';
import 'app_loader.dart';

/// DokuCheckoutSheet: In-App Modal Pembayaran DOKU dengan Deteksi Otomatis
/// Menampilkan halaman DOKU di dalam modal aplikasi tanpa perlu terlempar ke Chrome.
/// Dilengkapi background status synchronization (inquiry real-time) yang otomatis
/// mendeteksi keberhasilan pembayaran dan menutup pop-up seketika transaksi tuntas.
class DokuCheckoutSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final String paymentUrl;
  final String invoiceNumber;
  final String? trxId;
  final String? planTitle;
  final int? amount;

  const DokuCheckoutSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.paymentUrl,
    required this.invoiceNumber,
    this.trxId,
    this.planTitle,
    this.amount,
  });

  /// Helper untuk membuka modal secara elegan dari layar manapun
  static Future<bool?> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    required String paymentUrl,
    required String invoiceNumber,
    String? trxId,
    String? planTitle,
    int? amount,
  }) {
    return showModalBottomSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      enableDrag: false,
      isDismissible: false,
      builder: (context) => DokuCheckoutSheet(
        paymentUrl: paymentUrl,
        invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber,
        trxId: trxId,
        planTitle: planTitle,
        amount: amount,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<DokuCheckoutSheet> createState() => _DokuCheckoutSheetState();
}

class _DokuCheckoutSheetState extends State<DokuCheckoutSheet> {
  final SubscriptionService _subService = SubscriptionService();

  InAppWebViewController? _webController;
  Timer? _pollTimer;
  StreamSubscription<QuerySnapshot>? _txSubscription;
  double _loadProgress = 0.0;
  bool _isChecking = false;
  bool _isSuccess = false;
  int _pollAttempts = 0;
  bool _isShowingConfirmDialog = false;
  bool _hasPopped = false;
  final _completion = CheckoutCompletion();
  BuildContext? _confirmationContext;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // 1. Real-time Firestore Listener: mendeteksi instan saat status berubah jadi 'success' (< 1s)
    final currentUid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    if (widget.invoiceNumber.isNotEmpty && currentUid != null) {
      _txSubscription = FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection(AppConstants.colTransactions)
          .where('uid', isEqualTo: currentUid)
          .where('invoice_number', isEqualTo: widget.invoiceNumber)
          .limit(1)
          .snapshots()
          .listen(
            (snap) {
              if (snap.docs.isNotEmpty) {
                final data = snap.docs.first.data() as Map<String, dynamic>?;
                final status = (data?['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
                if (status == 'paid' || status == 'success') {
                  _triggerSuccess();
                }
              }
            },
            onError: (_) {
              // Jika query ditolak atau gagal, biarkan fail-safe polling tetap berjalan
            },
          );
    }

    // 2. Active inquiry polling setiap 2 detik sebagai fail-safe
    _pollTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 5), (_) {
      _checkPaymentStatus();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pollTimer?.cancel();
    _txSubscription?.cancel();
    _webController = null;
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _triggerSuccess() async {
    if (_isSuccess || _hasPopped || !mounted) return;
    _pollTimer?.cancel();
    _txSubscription?.cancel();
    setState(() {
      _isSuccess = true;
    });

    // Beri jeda 2.2 detik agar pengguna menikmati animasi sukses
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2200));
    await _completion.finish(
      dismissConfirmation: () {
        final dialogContext = _confirmationContext;
        if (dialogContext != null && dialogContext.mounted && ModalRoute.of(dialogContext)?.isCurrent == true) {
          Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(false);
        }
      },
      closeCheckout: () {
        if (mounted && !_hasPopped && ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent == true) {
          _hasPopped = true;
          Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
        }
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _checkPaymentStatus() async {
    if (_isChecking || _isSuccess || _hasPopped || !mounted) return;
    if (widget.invoiceNumber.isEmpty) return;

    _pollAttempts++;
    // F33: Batas maksimal polling 150 kali (5 menit) agar tidak memboroskan sumber daya
    if (_pollAttempts > 60) {
      _pollTimer?.cancel();
      return;
    }

    _isChecking = true;
    try {
      final res = await _subService.verifyPaymentStatus(
        invoiceNumber: widget.invoiceNumber,
        trxId: widget.trxId,
      );

      if (res['status'] == 'SUCCESS' || res['success'] == true) {
        _triggerSuccess();
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Polling background gagal sementara, lanjut ke tick berikutnya
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        _isChecking = false;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _handleWillPop() async {
    if (_isSuccess || _hasPopped) return false;
    if (_isShowingConfirmDialog) return false;

    _isShowingConfirmDialog = true;
    final confirmationDone = Completer<void>();
    _completion.confirmation = confirmationDone.future;
    try {
      final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
      final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (ctx) {
          _confirmationContext = ctx;
          return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard)),
          title: Text(
            'Tutup halaman pembayaran?',
            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight,
            ),
          ),
          content: Text(
            'Menutup halaman ini tidak otomatis membatalkan transaksi jika pembayaran telah diproses. Transaksi Anda tetap tercatat di sistem.',
            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
              fontSize: 13,
              color: isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight,
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: Text(
                'Lanjutkan',
                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                  color: isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
              child: Text(
                'Tutup',
                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                  color: AppTheme.appleRed,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
          );
        },
      );

      return !_isSuccess && (confirm ?? false);
    } finally {
      _confirmationContext = null;
      _isShowingConfirmDialog = false;
      confirmationDone.complete();
      _completion.confirmation = null;
    }
  }

  /// OT-F005: Destination allowlist ketat untuk WebView transaksi pembayaran
  bool _isAllowedPaymentDestination(Uri uri) {
    if (uri.scheme != 'https') return false;

    final host = uri.host.toLowerCase();
    
    // Domain aplikasi OpenTurath
    if (host == 'openturath-ai.web.app' ||
        host == 'openturath.ai' ||
        host.endsWith('.openturath.ai')) {
      return true;
    }

    // Domain resmi payment gateway DOKU & sandbox
    if (host == 'doku.com' ||
        host.endsWith('.doku.com') ||
        host == 'doku.id' ||
        host.endsWith('.doku.id')) {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surfaceColor = isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
    final textSecondary = isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;
    final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
    final accent = isDark ? AppTheme.accentDark : AppTheme.accentLight;

    final screenHeight = MediaQuery.of(context).size.height;

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) async {
        if (didPop) return;
        final shouldPop = await _handleWillPop();
        if (shouldPop && context.mounted && !_hasPopped) {
          _hasPopped = true;
          Navigator.of(context).pop(false);
        }
      },
      child: Container(
        height: screenHeight * 0.92,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: surfaceColor,
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard)),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withAlpha(isDark ? 100 : 40),
              blurRadius: 24,
              offset: const Offset(0, -4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard)),
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              // ── 1. Main Sheet Content (Header + WebView) ──
              Column(
                children: [
                  // Top Drag Handle & Title Bar
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: surfaceColor,
                      border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: border, width: 1)),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        // Drag Indicator
                        Center(
                          child: Container(
                            width: 36,
                            height: 4,
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: border,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusPill),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        Row(
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withAlpha(30),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusXS),
                              ),
                              child: const Icon(
                                Icons.lock_rounded,
                                size: 18,
                                color: Color(0xFF10B981),
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 10),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  Text(
                                    'Pembayaran',
                                    style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                      fontSize: 15,
                                      color: textPrimary,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  if (widget.invoiceNumber.isNotEmpty)
                                    Text(
                                      widget.invoiceNumber,
                                      style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                        letterSpacing: 0.3,
                                        color: textSecondary,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                            // Tombol Cek Manual / Refresh
                            IconButton(
                              onPressed: _isChecking
                                  ? null
                                  : () {
                                      _webController?.reload();
                                      _checkPaymentStatus();
                                    },
                              icon: _isChecking
                                  ? const SizedBox(
                                      width: 16,
                                      height: 16,
                                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                                    )
                                  : Icon(Icons.sync_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                              tooltip: 'Muat ulang status',
                            ),
                            // Close Button
                            IconButton(
                              onPressed: () async {
                                final shouldPop = await _handleWillPop();
                                if (shouldPop && context.mounted && !_hasPopped) {
                                  _hasPopped = true;
                                  Navigator.of(context).pop(false);
                                }
                              },
                              icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 22, color: textSecondary),
                              tooltip: 'Tutup',
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),

                  // Linear Progress Bar saat memuat halaman WebView
                  if (_loadProgress < 1.0)
                    LinearProgressIndicator(
                      value: _loadProgress,
                      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                      color: accent,
                      minHeight: 2.5,
                    ),

                  // WebView DOKU
                  Expanded(
                    child: InAppWebView(
                      initialUrlRequest: URLRequest(url: WebUri(widget.paymentUrl)),
                      initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
                        javaScriptEnabled: true,
                        domStorageEnabled: true,
                        databaseEnabled: true,
                        sharedCookiesEnabled: true,
                        thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
                        useHybridComposition: true,
                        mixedContentMode: MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
                        allowFileAccess: false,
                        allowContentAccess: true,
                        javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically: true,
                        supportZoom: true,
                        builtInZoomControls: true,
                        displayZoomControls: false,
                        forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
                        transparentBackground: false,
                      ),
                      onWebViewCreated: (controller) {
                        _webController = controller;
                      },
                      onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) {
                        if (mounted) {
                          setState(() {
                            _loadProgress = progress / 100.0;
                          });
                        }
                      },
                      shouldOverrideUrlLoading: (controller, navigationAction) async {
                        final webUri = navigationAction.request.url;
                        if (webUri == null) return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;

                        final uri = Uri.tryParse(webUri.toString());
                        if (uri == null || !_isAllowedPaymentDestination(uri)) {
                          debugPrint('[DokuCheckout] Navigation to untrusted destination rejected: $webUri');
                          return NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                        }

                        final urlStr = uri.toString().toLowerCase();

                        // Intersep jika DOKU mengarah ke callback URL kita atau URL sukses
                        if (urlStr.contains('openturath-ai.web.app') ||
                            urlStr.contains('callback') ||
                            urlStr.contains('finish') ||
                            urlStr.contains('checkout-success')) {
                          _checkPaymentStatus();
                          return NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW;
                        }

                        return NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW;
                      },
                      onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
                        if (mounted) {
                          setState(() => _loadProgress = 1.0);
                        }

                        final urlStr = url?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';
                        if (urlStr.contains('openturath-ai.web.app') ||
                            urlStr.contains('checkout-link') ||
                            urlStr.contains('success')) {
                          _checkPaymentStatus();
                        }

                        // Deteksi instan jika DOM DOKU menampilkan halaman Payment Successful
                        try {
                          final isPaidDom = await controller.evaluateJavascript(source: """
                            (function() {
                              var text = (document.body ? document.body.innerText : '') || '';
                              if (text.includes('Payment Successful') || 
                                  text.includes('Pembayaran Berhasil') || 
                                  text.includes('Berhasil!')) {
                                return true;
                              }
                              return false;
                            })();
                          """);
                          if (isPaidDom == true) {
                            _checkPaymentStatus();
                          }
                        } catch (_) {}
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              // ── 2. Celebratory Success Overlay ──
              if (_isSuccess)
                _CelebratorySuccessView(
                  surfaceColor: surfaceColor,
                  textPrimary: textPrimary,
                  textSecondary: textSecondary,
                  accent: accent,
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CelebratorySuccessView extends StatelessWidget {
  final Color surfaceColor;
  final Color textPrimary;
  final Color textSecondary;
  final Color accent;

  const _CelebratorySuccessView({
    required this.surfaceColor,
    required this.textPrimary,

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      builder: (context, opacity, child) {
        return Opacity(
          opacity: opacity,
          child: Container(
            color: surfaceColor,
            width: double.infinity,
            height: double.infinity,
            child: Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 32),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    // Spring bounce scale for the checkmark badge
                    TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 750),
                      curve: Curves.elasticOut,
                      builder: (context, scale, _) {
                        return Transform.scale(
                          scale: scale,
                          child: Container(
                            width: 88,
                            height: 88,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withValues(alpha: 0.16),

                                color: const Color(0xFF10B981),

                              ),
                              boxShadow: [

                                  color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withValues(alpha: 0.3),

                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                            child: const Icon(
                              Icons.check_rounded,
                              size: 50,
                              color: Color(0xFF10B981),
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 28),
                    // "Alhamdulillah!" with fade-up
                    TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                      builder: (context, value, _) {
                        return Opacity(
                          opacity: value.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                          child: Transform.translate(
                            offset: Offset(0, (1.0 - value) * 16),
                            child: Text(
                              'Alhamdulillah',
                              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                fontSize: 26,
                                letterSpacing: -0.5,
                                color: textPrimary,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    // "Pembayaran Berhasil Diverifikasi"
                    TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 600),
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                      builder: (context, value, _) {
                        return Opacity(
                          opacity: value.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                          child: Transform.translate(
                            offset: Offset(0, (1.0 - value) * 14),
                            child: Text(
                              'Pembayaran berhasil',
                              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                fontSize: 16,
                                color: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    // Description
                    TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                      tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0),
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 700),
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                      builder: (context, value, _) {
```

```dart
class EvidenceBottomSheet extends StatelessWidget {
  final int citationNumber;
  final String bookName;
  final String author;
  final String pageNumber;
  final String category;
  final String arabicExcerpt;
  final String explanation;
  final String? externalUrl;

  const EvidenceBottomSheet({
    super.key,
    required this.citationNumber,
    required this.bookName,
    required this.author,
    required this.pageNumber,
    required this.category,
    required this.arabicExcerpt,
    required this.explanation,
    this.externalUrl,
  });

  Future<void> _launchExternal(BuildContext context) async {
    final query = Uri.encodeComponent(bookName);
    final url = externalUrl != null && externalUrl!.isNotEmpty
        ? Uri.parse(externalUrl!)
        : Uri.parse('https://shamela.ws/search?q=$query');

    try {
      final canLaunch = await canLaunchUrl(url);
      if (canLaunch) {
        await launchUrl(url, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      } else {
        if (context.mounted) {
          AppSnackBar.error(context, 'Tidak dapat membuka rujukan eksternal: $url');
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _copyIbarah(BuildContext context) {
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: arabicExcerpt));
    AppSnackBar.success(context, 'Ibarah tersalin.');
  }

  void _shareEvidence(BuildContext context) {
    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    buffer.writeln('📖 *Rujukan Ilmiah: $bookName*');
    buffer.writeln('Pengarang: $author');
    buffer.writeln('Disiplin: $category | Halaman: $pageNumber');
    buffer.writeln();
    if (arabicExcerpt.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('نص العبارة:');
      buffer.writeln('« $arabicExcerpt »');
      buffer.writeln();
    }
    if (explanation.isNotEmpty) {
      buffer.writeln('Taqrir & Syarah:');
      buffer.writeln(explanation);
    }

    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: buffer.toString()));
    AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.referenceCopied);
  }

  Widget _stagger(int index, Widget child) {

          child: Opacity(
            opacity: value.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            child: animChild,
          ),
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
```

```dart
}) {
```

```dart
    context,
    AppRoutes.bookCatalog,
    arguments: agent,
  );

class ResearchLibrarySheet extends StatefulWidget {
  const ResearchLibrarySheet({super.key, this.agent});

  @override
  State<ResearchLibrarySheet> createState() => _ResearchLibrarySheetState();
}

class _ResearchLibrarySheetState extends State<ResearchLibrarySheet> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final CanonicalLibraryService _service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _allBooks;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _filteredBooks;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;
  String? _selectedEra;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
    _searchController.addListener(_onSearchChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.removeListener(_onSearchChanged);
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSearchChanged() {
    if (_allBooks == null) return;
    setState(() {
      _filteredBooks = _service.filterBooks(
        _allBooks!,
        _searchController.text,
        eraFilter: _selectedEra,
      );
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final List<CanonicalBookPresentation> books;
      if (widget.agent != null) {
        books = await _service.loadCatalogForAgent(widget.agent!);
      } else {
        books = await _service.loadSyafiiCatalog();
      }
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allBooks = books;
        _filteredBooks = books;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.catalogLoadFailed;
        _isLoading = false;
```
